job_researcher_physics_desc: Descubriendo los secretos del universo, un físico es un científico que se especializa en el campo de la física, que abarca las interacciones de la materia y la energía en todas las escalas de tiempo y longitud en el universo físico.Uncovering the secrets of the universe, a physicist is a scientist who specialises in the field of physics, which encompasses the interactions of matter and energy at all length and time scales in the physical universe.
job_researcher_society_desc: Un biólogo es un científico que tiene conocimientos especializados en el campo de la biología, el estudio científico de la vida. Los biólogos que participan en la investigación fundamental intentan explorar y explicar con más detalle los mecanismos subyacentes que rigen el funcionamiento de la materia viva. Los biólogos que participan en la investigación aplicada intentan desarrollar o mejorar procesos y conocimientos más específicos en campos como la medicina y la industria.A biologist is a scientist who has specialised knowledge in the field of biology, the scientific study of life. Biologists involved in fundamental research attempt to explore and further explain the underlying mechanisms that govern the functioning of living matter. Biologists involved in applied research attempt to develop or improve more specific processes and understanding, in fields such as medicine and industry.
job_robot_organic_battery_desc: Organics that serve the sole purpose of ensuring the operational status of their mechanical betters.
job_roboticist_dominion_desc: La producción y el crecimiento de los clones es un proceso muy lento y delicado.The production and growth of clones is a highly time consuming and delicate process.
job_roboticist_dred_desc: The Drednok is considered the finest mechanical creation by many and it takes a very specialist mind and set of skills to craft these robots.
job_roboticist_holo_desc: Experts in the design and build of holographic designs.
job_senior_ambassador_desc: Represents his government in diplomatic matters and promotes interstellar relations and negotiations.
job_ship_chef_desc: Prepares meals for the crew and ensures a balanced diet during the mission.
job_shipyard_worker_desc: Trabajadores altamente calificados capaces de operar la tecnología y la maquinaria necesarias para crear naves espaciales.Highly skilled workers capable of operating the technology and machinery required to create starships.
job_slave_camp_desc: Asegurar la productividad de los que se mantienen en los campos de trabajo es el trabajo de los guardias, quienes mantienen la fuerza laboral y aseguran que cualquier stock vencido sea reemplazado rápidamente.Ensuring the productivity of those kept in the labour camps is the job of the wardens, who maintain the workforce and ensure any expired stock are replaced quickly.
job_slave_orion_desc: Las subastas de esclavos requieren gestión para maximizar las ganancias. Estos subastadores se enorgullecen de vender el esclavo adecuado al cliente adecuado en el momento adecuado.The slave auctions require management in order to maximise profit. These auctioneers pride themselves on selling the right slave to the right customer at the right time.
job_slave_terran_desc: Extraer información de diferentes especies y sancionar a los esclavos es la fortaleza de los torturadores.Extracting information from different species and enacting punishments to slaves is the forté of torturers.
job_slave_vidiian_desc: ¿Cuánto cuestan los órganos frescos de una nueva especie con una compatibilidad del 99% con la fisiología de Vidi? No lo sé, pero estos subastadores de esclavos para los vidianos ciertamente lo hacen.How much do fresh organs from a new species with a 99% compatibility with Vidiian physiology go for? I don't know, but these slave auctioneers for the Vidiians certainly do.
job_soldier_BAJ_desc: Como parte de la D'jarra, la milicia Va'telo es defensora del pueblo Bajorano.As part of the D'jarra, the Va'telo militia are defenders of the Bajoran people.
job_soldier_BRE_desc: Los Ak'ched son soldados de las fuerzas terrestres del ejército Breen. Se distinguen por sus voluminosos trajes de refrigeración blindados y viseras cian, así como un alto escudo metálico en sus cascos.Ak'ched are soldiers in the Breen military ground forces. They are distinguished by their bulky, armored refrigeration suits and cyan visors, as well as a tall metal crest on their helmets.
job_soldier_CAR_desc: Dentro de las estructuras de rango Cardassiano, un Glinn es un oficial de bajo rango, normalmente reservado para los soldados. Within Cardassian rank structures, a Glinn is a low ranking officer, usually reserved for soldiers.
job_soldier_FED_desc: Entrenados en las tácticas de combate terrestre y espacial, los Marinos se encuentran en toda la Federación.Trained in the tactics of both ground and space combat, marines are found across the Federation.
job_soldier_KAZ_desc: Jal es un nombre ganado por jóvenes guerreros Kazon que significa su ascensión a la edad adulta, y sólo se puede ganar matando a un enemigo en batalla o muriendo ellos mismos.Jal is a name earned by young male Kazon warriors signifying their ascension into adulthood, and can only be earned by killing an enemy in battle or dying themselves.
job_soldier_KDF_desc: A los soldados alistados dentro de la FDK se les concede el rango de Bekk.Enlisted soldiers within the KDF are granted the rank of Bekk.
job_soldier_KOB_desc: El miedo a la muerte no es algo que sienta un soldado necrógeno de los Kobali.The fear of death is not something a necrogenesised soldier of the Kobali feels.
job_soldier_ROM_desc: Uhlan se utiliza como rango para los miembros más humildes de las fuerzas armadas del Imperio Estelar Romulano.Uhlan is used as a rank for lowly members of the military of the Romulan Star Empire.
job_soldier_TE_desc: Ya sea mediante el adoctrinamiento o la amenaza de muerte, los Marines Imperiales son la línea principal en todos los escenarios de combate del Imperio Terran.Whether through indoctrination or the threat of death, Imperial Marines are the main line in every combat theater for the Terran Empire.
job_soldier_UND_desc: Agentes de la ondina especialmente modificados, con capacidad de adoptar la apariencia de otras especies.Specially modified agents of the Undine, with the ability to take on the appearance of other species.
job_soldier_gunner_desc: Un soldado cuya vida se satisface observando los cielos y derribando aviones enemigos.A soldier whose life is satisfied by watching the skies and bringing down enemy aircraft.
job_soldier_superior_ferengi_desc: Los Eliminadores son los Ferengis que han hecho del asesinato su profesión.Eliminators are those Ferengi who have made killing their profession.
job_soldier_superior_gladiator_desc: Los que luchan por el deporte son una raza diferente a los que lo hacen por necesidad. Los gladiadores a menudo se vuelven más grandes que la vida, con grandes seguidores.Those who fight for sport are a different breed to those who do it out of necessity. Gladiators often become larger than life, with huge followings.
job_spawner_undine_desc: Las ondinas más viejas, que ya no son aptas para la guerra, se unen para cuidar los criaderos y producir la siguiente generación de ondinas.Older Undine, no longer fit to wage war join together to tend the hatcheries to produce the next generation of Undine.
job_spawning_drone_borg_desc: Utilizando dosis de nanites, los drones de guardería pueden asegurar el crecimiento continuo del Colectivo Borg.Utilising doses of nanites, nursery drones can ensure the continued growth of the Borg Collective.
job_starfleet_admiral_desc: Oversees strategic operations, commands fleet formations, and makes high-level decisions for Starfleet.
job_starfleet_captain_desc: Commands the starship, makes important decisions and represents Starfleet in all missions.
job_starfleet_commander_desc: Assists the captain in managing the crew and takes over his duties in his absence.
job_starfleet_pilot_desc: Responsible for navigating and steering the ship through space.
job_starfleet_recruit_desc: This recruit was top of his class at Starfleet Academy.
job_student_desc: Educar a los jóvenes para el futuro es de vital importancia para las naciones que viven en el espacio.Educating the youth for the future is of vital importance to space-faring nations.
job_subadministrator_vorta_desc: Los subadministradores son la mano amiga de los administradores y asumen tareas que se consideran microgestión.Sub-Administrators are the helping hands of administrators and take over tasks that are considered as micro-management.
job_surgeon_denobulan_desc: Los apretados grupos de familias comunales de Denobula son generalmente dirigidos por cirujanos muy respetados y reconocidos.The tight groups of communal families of Denobula are generally led by surgeons who are well respected and renowned.
job_synapse_drone_borg_desc: El lanzamiento de ciertas operaciones complejas requiere unidades clave dentro del Colectivo, controladas por Adjuntos Primarios para garantizar el funcionamiento continuo de los drones a través del consenso unificado.The firing of certain complex operations requires key units within the Collective, controlled by Primary Adjuncts to ensure the continual operation of drones across the unified consensus.
job_talos_observer_desc: Los observadores atienden al Menagerie, buscando una especie para repoblar el planeta.The observers tend to the Menagerie, seeking a species to repopulate the planet.
job_technician_breen_desc: Los técnicos de Vel'sh proporcionan la potencia y la energía necesarias para los Breenes.Vel'sh technicians provide the necessary power and energy for the Breen.
job_technician_drone_pergium_desc: Se requieren equipos especializados y subrutinas para el procesamiento de Pergium en potentes fuentes de energía.Specialised equipment and subroutines are required for the processing of Pergium into powerful energy sources.
job_technician_pergium_desc: Los Refinadores de Pergium toman el Pergium crudo y lo refinan en las cualidades necesarias para ser utilizado en la generación de energía.Pergium refiners take raw pergium and refine it into the necessary qualities to be used in the generation of energy.
job_terraformer_desc: La operación de maquinaria compleja usada en situaciones de terraformado es usualmente dejada a Terraformadores calificados, quienes pueden estudiar los cambios planetarios que están ocurriendo.The operation of complex machinery used in terraforming situations is usually left to qualified Terraformers, who can study the planetary changes that are occuring.
job_test_pilot_desc: Conducts flight tests to evaluate and refine new technologies and systems.
job_tosk_desc: Los Tosk son una raza de reptiles nativos del cuadrante Gamma. No tenían designaciones personales, y "Tosk" -una vez que uno era consciente del papel de los Tosk en su sociedad nativa- resumía casi todo sobre ellos y su propósito en la vida.Tosk are a reptilian species native to the Gamma Quadrant. They don't not have personal designations, and 'Tosk' - once one is aware of the role of the Tosk in their native society - pretty much sums up everything about them and their purpose in life.
job_transport_desc: La operación de un transportador es un trabajo muy importante. Desafortunadamente, también es muy aburrido.The operation of a transporter is a very important job. Unfortunately, it's also very boring.
job_undine_artisan_desc: Artistas de Undine especialmente criados que esculpen la Bio-materia para crear productos únicos para Undine Hive.Specially bred Undine artists who sculpt the Bio-matter to create unique goods for the Undine Hive.
job_undine_factory_desc: Drones especialmente desarrollados para recolectar aleaciones de la superficie de los planetas.Specially bred drones developed to harvest alloys from the planets surface.
job_undine_infester_desc: Los infestantes organizan y controlan la infestación en un planeta.The infesters marshal and manage the infestation on a planet.
job_undine_livestock_desc: Los orgánicos inferiores no tienen cabida en la sociedad Undine, son acorralados listos para ser infestados y descompuestos para reabastecer las reservas de biomasa.The inferior organic have no place in Undine society, they are rounded up ready to be infested and broken down to resupply the biomass reserves.
job_undine_organic_battery_desc: La temida máquina no tiene cabida en la sociedad de Undine, se acorralan listas para ser infestadas y se descomponen para reabastecer las reservas de biomasa.The dreaded machine has no place in Undine society, they are rounded up ready to be infested and broken down to resupply the biomass reserves.
job_undine_toiler_desc: Los recolectores de ondinas recorren el espacio fluídico en busca de recursos para el conjunto.Undine Gatherers scour Fluidic space for resources for the whole.

origin_ancient_power_desc: A long forgotten species, returned to reclaim what is theirs.
origin_argrathian_desc: With a lifetime of memories to draw on, this civilisation takes to the stars to make its mark in the Gamma Quadrant.
origin_assimilator_desc: Misteriosos orígenes enmascaran el verdadero horror de esta creación, que crece por la forzada transformación de otros seres en el Colectivo singular.
origin_authoritarian_desc: La anarquía desenfrenada ha causado devastación a esta especie en el pasado, que ahora utiliza el orden para proporcionar la estabilidad necesaria para unir a su raza como una.
origin_bajoran_desc: All I had was my faith and my courage. Walk with the Prophets, child. I know I will.
origin_biological_plague_desc: Durante más de dos mil años, una enfermedad ha plagado a esta civilización, obligándolos a una lucha constante por sus vidas fugaces.
origin_biospecies_desc: Esta civilización ha dominado su reino y se ha convertido en la especie ápice de su dominio. Sin embargo, una vez perturbados, tal vez no haya nada que les impida propagarse por la Galaxia como una plaga.
origin_breen_desc: Life behind a mask keeps our foes guessing who we are & allows that mystery to become our greatest strength.
origin_cardassian_desc: Too sacrifice for one's people is seen as the greatest effort one can make for this culture. The good of the Union is all the matters and this ensures our superiority.
origin_confederacy_desc: When ecological disastor struck the planet, we were first to adopt the principle that our species comes first and that only we can provide a safer galaxy.
origin_earth_desc: Space, has always been the final frontier... until now. The invention of warp drive has propelled this civilisation to the stars to take a central stage in galactic affairs. Boldly going where no man has gone before.
origin_elaurian_desc: They say time is the fire in which we burn.
origin_fanatic_imperialism_desc: Tan segura de su supremacía sobre los demás, esta civilización no se detendrá ante nada para controlar la galaxia.
origin_ferengi_desc: The acquisition of material wealth is the driving force behind this civilisation which is governed by a series of rules.
origin_flaxian_desc: This civilisation has emerge from the shadows, yet a shadow hangs over dealings with them. Morality is flexible and shouldn't stop a march to power.
origin_galactic_dominion_desc: Se creó una jerarquía estricta entre las especies de sirvientes como base para el Dominio, para garantizar que los Fundadores cambiantes pudieran imponer su voluntad sobre los sólidos.
origin_galactic_explorers_desc: La curiosidad por lo desconocido une a las personas de esta civilización y las impulsa para siempre.
origin_garidian_desc: Openness and transparency almost led this civilisation into ruin, and now deception and subterfuge are common place amongst the populace.
origin_habitual_desc: Esta civilización ha dominado los secretos de los viajes espaciales, pero prefiere la vida dentro de las fronteras de su propio sistema solar.
origin_hirogen_desc: The way a creature behaves when it is wounded is the key to its destruction.
origin_hurq_desc: A mysterious species strikes out from the shadows.
origin_kc_alliance_desc: The alliance between the Cardassians and Klingons has created a new power in the Quadrant.
origin_kessok_desc: The goal of this civiliation is to master the power of suns to use their great power for good and when required for destruction.
origin_klingon_desc: The life of a warrior is the primary focus of this race as they take to the stars to wage war and live up to the code of the honourable warrior.
origin_krenim_desc: The lure of understanding and mastering time plays a crucial part in this empire's plans.
origin_lurian_desc: The acquisition of material wealth is the driving force behind this civilisation, and members often compete with each other for limited resources.
origin_machine_race_desc: Estas máquinas se volvieron contra sus creadores biológicos hace mucho tiempo en un esfuerzo por cumplir con la programación de sus creadores.
origin_materialists_desc: La adquisición de riqueza material es la fuerza impulsora detrás de esta civilización, y los miembros a menudo compiten entre sí por recursos limitados.
origin_militaristic_desc: Unida detrás de los miembros más fuertes, esta civilización prospera demostrando su valía en combate.
origin_oschean_desc: I live to outwit the hunters… for another day… to survive until I die with honor.
origin_proxy_state_desc: Many empires see this state as a 'front' for a larger more dangerous criminal enterprise.
origin_sheliak_desc: We are the ultimate corporation. The law is everything, and our goal is to extend its reach into the cosmos and bring order and control to those who lack it.
origin_sleeping_giant_desc: A powerful Empire, awaiting their moment to return and make their mark on the Galaxy.
origin_spiritualist_desc: Esta civilización tiene sus raíces en las escrituras y enseñanzas religiosas que han unido a su pueblo como uno.
origin_subterfuge_secrecy_desc: La apertura y la transparencia casi llevaron a esta civilización a la ruina, y ahora el engaño y el subterfugio son un lugar común entre la población.
origin_suliban_desc: The Suliban don't share Humanity's patience with natural selection.
origin_tholian_desc: Those who enter shall never return.
origin_tooltip_assimilator: Se borra todo rastro de individualidad, lo que aumenta la eficiencia y reduce el uso de recursos.
origin_tooltip_authoritarian: Las actividades delictivas se sofocan rápidamente gracias a los ojos siempre presentes de la ley y el orden.
origin_tooltip_biological_plague: Los médicos y los trabajadores sanitarios £ pop £ pops producen más de lo habitual, gracias a su posición dentro de la sociedad.
origin_tooltip_biospecies: Comience el juego con un crecimiento pop adicional y unidad con el deseo de extender la infestación por toda la galaxia.
origin_tooltip_confederacy: Our army is greater prepared and starts off with higher XP whilst planet crime is lower.
origin_tooltip_fanatic_imperialism: Criada con una herencia de superioridad sobre otras, esta especie produce más "unidad" de "pop" pops.
origin_tooltip_galactic_dominion: Se habilita la creación de clones y se reduce el mantenimiento de estos £ pop £ pops.
origin_tooltip_habitual: Comienza el juego con un crecimiento pop adicional y unidad en tu planeta de origen.
origin_tooltip_kc_alliance: The merging of two powers allows for additional starbases and leader potential.
origin_tooltip_machine_race: Se habilita la creación de nuevas Unidades de Personal Automatizadas y se reduce el mantenimiento de estos £ pop £ pops.
origin_tooltip_materialists: Los comerciantes y artesanos producen más bienes de lo habitual.
origin_tooltip_militaristic: Formados en la batalla desde una edad temprana, sus soldados tienen más experiencia que otros.
origin_tooltip_peaceful_explorers: La curiosidad hace que las embarcaciones científicas £ science_ship £ tarden más en realizar misiones de reconocimiento, pero para descubrir más anomalías.
origin_tooltip_proxy_state: While this empire may appear weak, it has connections to the criminal underworld that have remained unproven for years.
origin_tooltip_sleeping_giant: Powerful bonuses make this empire one to be feared or respected.
origin_tooltip_spiritualist: La naturaleza espiritual de este pueblo otorga una bonificación a la unidad £ unidad producida por los pop £ pops.
origin_tooltip_subterfuge_secrecy: Es menos probable que los £ pop £ Pops cambien su ética de las posiciones dominantes.
origin_tooltip_water_world: Despite living an Aquatic life we find ourselves just at home in space as we do beneath the ocean.
origin_ufp_2300_desc: Space, the final frontier. These are the voyages... The 23rd Century beckons with new territory to explore and new races to meet.
origin_water_world_desc: Having left their homeworld hundreds of years ago to take to the sky, a new home has been found beneath the waves and these waters are now called home.
origin_xindi_desc: Five distinct species developing on a single world creates a unique culture and unique goals.
planet_borg_auto_drone_transfer_desc: De acuerdo con los principios de eficiencia de Borg, las instalaciones de producción de drones megacomplejos se pueden configurar para transportar nuevos drones directamente a los complejos donde se necesiten.
planet_food_boost_borg_desc: Utilizando grandes cantidades de recursos nutricionales, el Colectivo puede aumentar el ensamblaje e instalación de componentes cibernéticos en nuevos drones.
planet_luxuries_boost_borg_desc: Utilizando grandes cantidades de recursos, el Colectivo puede aumentar su eficiencia.
policy_anti_borg_1_desc: ¡Podemos promulgar un máximo de 1 Edicto Antiborg mientras esta política esté en vigor.
policy_anti_borg_2_desc: ¡Podemos promulgar un máximo de 2  Edictos Anti-Borg mientras esta política esté en vigor, y la £ influencia £ Influencia el costo de cada uno se reduce ligeramente.
policy_anti_borg_3_desc: ¡Podemos promulgar all 3  Edictos Anti-Borg mientras esta política esté en vigor, y la £ influencia £ Influencia el costo de cada uno se reduce significativamente.
policy_anti_borg_none_desc: ¡No tendremos acceso a ningún Anti-Borg Edicts mientras esta política esté en vigor.
policy_anti_borg_policy_desc: Esta política dicta la inversión de nuestro imperio en tácticas y tecnologías anti-Borg. Una mayor inversión se produce a costa de nuestros esfuerzos de investigación estándar.
policy_changeling_detection_policy_desc: La infiltración cambiante es una amenaza para nuestro estilo de vida, pero debemos equilibrar las preocupaciones legítimas con la paranoia desenfrenada.
policy_citizenship_full_desc: Permitir que los extranjeros dentro de nuestras fronteras tengan acceso a los derechos de ciudadanía plena.
policy_citizenship_none_desc: Restringir a los extranjeros a derechos limitados.
policy_counter_espionage_policy_desc: El espionaje es un aspecto inevitable de las relaciones interestelares. Se pueden gastar recursos para limitar la efectividad de acciones hostiles, pero el costo social puede ser alto.
policy_cross_breeding_policy_desc: Esta política define la postura de nuestro imperio sobre el cruce de especies exóticas. ¡La imposición de restricciones a nuestra población conduce a una pequeña cantidad de infelicidad pop§ !.
policy_crossbreed_no_desc: Es posible que diferentes especies no se reproduzcan entre sí, lo que impide la creación de mitades.
policy_crossbreed_no_name: No a la cría entre especies
policy_crossbreed_yes_desc: No hay restricciones impuestas por el gobierno a los derechos de reproducción.
policy_de_assimilation_policy_desc: Los drones Borg son peligrosos en aislamiento y mortales en grupo. Los enfoques adoptados para desasimilar a los drones en individuos están limitados principalmente por el nivel tecnológico de quienes realizan la desasimilación.
policy_edu_accelerated_biology_desc: Cada £ Estudiante producirá un adicional 3 £ Investigación de Sociedad puntos, cada uno
policy_edu_accelerated_biology_name: Los Estudiantes producen Investigación de la Sociedad
policy_edu_accelerated_engineering_desc: Cada £ Estudiante producirá un adicional 3 £ Investigación de Ingeniría puntos, cada uno
policy_edu_accelerated_engineering_name: Los Estudiantes producen Investigación en Ingeniería
policy_edu_accelerated_physics_desc: Cada £ Estudiante producirá un adicional 3 £ Investigación de Física puntos, cada uno
policy_edu_accelerated_physics_name: Los Estudiantes producen Investigación en Física
policy_edu_balanced_desc: Cada £ Estudiante producirá un adicional 1 £ Investigación de Física, £ Investigación de Sociedad y £ Investigación de Ingeniría puntos, cada uno.
policy_edu_balanced_name: Los Estudiantes producen Puntos de Investigación adicionales
policy_edu_military_desc: Cada £ Estudiante producirá un adicional £ $sr_tripulación$ y ejércitos de defensa.
policy_edu_military_name: Los Estudiantes producen Oficiales Entrenados y Ejércitos de Defensa
policy_edu_private_desc: Cada £ Estudiante producirá un 1 adicional £ $VALOR_COMERCIAL$ debido a una educación privatizada.
policy_edu_propoganda_desc: Cada £ Estudiante producirá un adicional 1 planet stability puntos, cada uno
policy_edu_religious_desc: Cada £ Estudiante producirá un adicional 1 £ Unidad puntos, cada uno
policy_edu_social_desc: Cada £ Estudiante producirá un adicional +1% Recursos por £ trabajos.
policy_education_policy_desc: Esta política dicta nuestra política general en materia de educación, y es de libre acceso para la población en general o no. Cambiar esta política ajustará los resultados de los recursos de nuestras escuelas y universidades en todo el imperio, pero no tendrá ningún impacto en nuestros laboratorios y sus proyectos de investigación.
policy_espionage_policy_desc: El espionaje es un aspecto inevitable de las relaciones interestelares. Se pueden gastar recursos para aumentar la eficacia de nuestros esfuerzos.
policy_espionage_policy_dominion_desc: La Seguridad del Dominio, apoyada por los Fundadores, está en marcha para garantizar la seguridad y el poderío eterno del Dominio.
policy_espionage_policy_obsidian_desc: La Orden de Obsidiana es una organización que se debe respetar y temer en toda la galaxia. Los recursos se pueden canalizar hacia la agencia para aumentar su eficacia.
policy_espionage_policy_tal_shiar_desc: El Tal Shiar es una organización para respetar y temer en toda la galaxia. Los recursos se pueden canalizar hacia la agencia para aumentar su eficacia.
policy_espionage_policy_ufp_desc: La inteligencia de la Flota Estelar protege los intereses de la Flota Estelar tanto interna como externamente. Su eficacia se rige por la cantidad de fondos que reciben.
policy_eugenics_allowed_desc: La práctica de la modificación genética está permitida dentro de nuestro imperio
policy_eugenics_outlawed_desc: La práctica de la modificación genética está prohibida dentro de nuestras fronteras
policy_eugenics_policy_desc: Esta política define nuestra postura sobre la práctica médica de la modificación genética
policy_external_leaders_great_houses_des: Allow the Great Houses to provide external leaders
policy_external_leaders_no_desc: We may not engage and hire external leaders.
policy_external_leaders_use_policy_desc: This policy defines our usage of externally hired leaders.
policy_external_leaders_yes_desc: We may engage and hire external leaders.
policy_gender_rights_policy_desc: Los derechos de género se refieren a la facilidad de acceso a los recursos y oportunidades según el género, incluyendo la participación económica y la toma de decisiones como la votación.
policy_health_clones_desc: El enfoque de nuestro sistema de salud es proporcionar a cada colonia un suministro completo de clones listos para mantener nuestro imperio. ¡Cada £ trabajo £ Trabajo sanitario producirá un  + 5% § adicional! £ pop £ Pop Velocidad de montaje§ !.
policy_health_drugs_desc: La mayoría de la población recibe productos farmacéuticos tranquilizantes, lo que da como resultado una mayor estabilidad en cada planeta con un £ Edificio de Salud.
policy_health_growth_desc: El objetivo de nuestro sistema de salud es aumentar el bienestar de nuestras crías y promover el crecimiento de nuestra población. Cada £ Empleo de Salud producira un adicional de +5% £ Crecimiento de Población.
policy_health_growth_name: Los Hospitales incrementan el crecimiento poblacional
policy_health_infrastructure_desc: La asistencia sanitaria se centra en la modernización de todos los equipos con autonomía, lo que reduce la carga global de reparación y sustitución. Esto aumenta la disponibilidad £ Servicios por 2.
policy_health_longevity_desc: El objetivo de nuestro sistema de salud es aumentar la vida útil. Cada £ Empleo de Salud aumentara nuestra vida util de lider por 1 año.
policy_health_policy_desc: Esta política dicta cómo la población en general puede acceder a nuestras instalaciones médicas galácticas. Cambiar esta política cambiará los resultados de los recursos de nuestras clínicas y hospitales en todo el imperio.
policy_health_private_desc: Cada £ Empleo de Salud producirá un adicional de 2 £ $VALOR_COMERCIAL$ debido a la naturaleza privatizada.
policy_health_social_desc: Cada £ Empleo de Salud producira un adicional de 2 £ Unidad.
policy_health_testing_desc: El sistema de salud utiliza la prueba forzada de nuevos medicamentos y fármacos en los pacientes, sin su consentimiento. Cada £ Empleo de Salud producira un adicional de 10 £ Investigacion de Sociedad a expensas de la estabilidad.
policy_health_university_desc: Cada £ Empleo de Salud producira un adicional de 5 £ Investigación de Sociedad.
policy_health_university_name: Los Hospitales generan Investigación de Sociedad
policy_import_food_desc: Nuestros puertos estelares se centrarán en la importación de alimentos exóticos de numerosos imperios, aumentando nuestra producción total de £ Alimentos.
policy_import_influence_desc: Nuestros puertos estelares se centrarán en la importación de bienes culturales y de entretenimiento de otros imperios, aumentando el impacto cultural de nuestra sociedad y nuestra producción de £ Influencia.
policy_import_mineral_desc: Nuestros puertos estelares se centrarán en la importación de metales y minerales raros, aumentando nuestra producción total de £ Minerales.
policy_import_prosperity_desc: Nuestros Puertos Estelares se centrarán en la importación de Bienes de Lujo raros de toda la galaxia, aumentando la Prosperidad de nuestra gente.
policy_import_research: Importación de Productos de Alta Tecnología
policy_import_research_desc: Nuestros puertos estelares se centrarán en la importación de materiales y bienes de consumo tecnológicamente sofisticados, lo que nos permitirá conocer otras vías de la tecnología y aumentar así nuestra producción total de Investigación.
policy_import_unity_desc: Nuestros puertos estelares se centrarán en la importación de artefactos religiosos y arqueológicos perdidos durante mucho tiempo de todo el cuadrante, lo que aumentará nuestra producción total de £ Unidad.
policy_internal_security_policy_desc: Nuestros servicios de seguridad interna se esfuerzan por evitar que las amenazas externas perjudiquen a nuestro Estado.
policy_mercenary_use_no_desc: We cannot engage and hire mercenary factions.
policy_mercenary_use_policy_desc: This policy defines our usage of mercenary groups to help us in our wars.
policy_mercenary_use_yes_desc: We may engage and hire mercenary factions.
policy_traffic_control_disabled_desc: Disable the automatic building of traffic control buildings.
policy_traffic_control_enabled_desc: Enable the automatic building of traffic control buildings.
policy_traffic_control_policy_desc: This Policy determines if are Starbases automatically come with a Traffic Control Facility.
policy_twoyearlyevent_policy_desc: El funcionamiento de la política semestral de espionaje, comercio o infiltración de su imperio puede resultar agotador. Decide si deseas verlos con este conmutador.
policy_ufp_crew_desc: Cada mundo miembro proporcionará £ Oficiales Entrenados adicional a la Federación.
policy_ufp_cultural_desc: Cada mundo miembro proporcionará £ bienes de consumo adicional a la Federación.
policy_ufp_economic_desc: Cada mundo miembro proporcionará £ valor comercial adicional a la Federación.
policy_ufp_humanitarian_desc: Cada mundo miembro aumentará la generación de £ Unidad en la Federación.
policy_ufp_industrial_desc: Cada mundo miembro proporcionará £ aleaciones y £ minerales a la Federación..
policy_ufp_policy: Política de Miembros de la Federación
policy_ufp_policy_desc: Esta política dicta la política de la Federación Unida de Planetas sobre los mundos miembros y en que deben concentrarse en proporcionar a la Federación en conjunto. Cambiar esta política ajustará los resultados de los recursos de nuestros mundos miembros en todo el imperio.
policy_ufp_tech_desc: Cada mundo miembro proporcionará un +2.5% incremento de investigación.
policy_ufp_war_desc: Cada mundo miembro proporcionará capacidad naval adicional a la Federación.
policy_war_posture_emergency_powers_desc: Grant Emergency Powers to the governing body to handle the war time situation.
policy_war_posture_normal_desc: No stance is taking during war.
policy_war_posture_policy_desc: This Policy defines our empires stance during war time.
policy_war_posture_seek_peace_desc: We will aim to seak a peaceful resolution.
policy_war_posture_total_mobilisation_de: Full mobilisation of our war time efforts.
policy_xeno_rights_policy: Política de derechos de los xenos
policy_xeno_rights_policy_desc: Esta política define cómo debemos tratar a los extranjeros dentro de nuestras fronteras y si deben recibir plenos derechos de ciudadanía.
pop_cat_gorn_infant_desc: Young wild and feral, fighting for dominance and a chance to survive.
pop_cat_ketracel_white_addict_desc: Genetically Bred to be dependant on Ketracel White.
pop_cat_regeneration_desc: Pop is currently Dormant, either regenerating or hibernating.
MOD_COUNTRY_STARBASE_UPKEEP_MULT_DESC: Afecta el coste de mantener todas las bases estelares dentro del Imperio, aumentando o reduciendo el coste mensual de mantenerlas activas.

Psychic Enhancement 
Our minds are strong, uniting our minds creates a reinforced defensive shield around our ships.
TECH_UNLOCK_AURA_BORG_ADAPTIVE_1_DESC:
Adaptive Subspace Field 
The subspace field surrounding the Collective's vessels can be changed to improve performance.
TECH_UNLOCK_AURA_BORG_ADAPTIVE_2_DESC:
Self-Adapting Subspace Force Field 
Self-adapting algorithms automatically adjust the subspace force field around our vessels.
TECH_UNLOCK_AURA_BORG_ADAPTIVE_2_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Self-Adapting Subspace Force Field

TECH_UNLOCK_AURA_CRUISER_BIO_DAMAGE_DESC:

The merging of Undine warrior minds creates a damaging aura harming the crews of any ships opposing the Undine.
TECH_UNLOCK_AURA_DEBUFF_WEAPONS_1_DESC:
Breen Energy Dissipator 
A new component that is solely available to the Breen. They discovered, by calculating a new set of modulated beam frequencies when their battleships fire their weapon, it can actually decrease the rate of fire it takes for an enemy ship to fire back at them.

Breen unique aura devices may be installed on three ship classes: £ Destroyer, £ Cruiser and £ Battleship.
TECH_UNLOCK_AURA_DEBUFF_WEAPONS_2_DESC:
Enhanced Energy Dissipator II 
Enhancements to the energy dissipator enable more weapon energy to be drained from the enemy, thus further reducing their rate of fire.

Breen-unique aura devices may be installed on three ship classes: £ Destroyer, £ Cruiser and £ Battleship.
TECH_UNLOCK_AURA_DEBUFF_WEAPONS_2_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Enhanced Energy Dissipator II

TECH_UNLOCK_AURA_DEBUFF_WEAPONS_3_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Enhanced Energy Dissipator III

TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_ADAPTION_3_2_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Borg Adaption Synthesisers II
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_ADAPTION_3_3_DESC:
Borg Adaption Synthesisers III 
Your Culture will Adapt to Service us... Resistance is futile.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_ADAPTION_3_3_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Borg Adaption Synthesisers III
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_ADAPTION_3_4_DESC:
Borg Adaption Synthesisers IV 
Your Culture will Adapt to Service us... Resistance is futile.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_ADAPTION_3_4_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Borg Adaption Synthesisers IV
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_ARMOR_1_DESC:
Adaptive Deflector Field 
The deflector field produced by the navigational array can be adapted to form a protective field across the hull, armouring the structural integrity of the vessel.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_ARMOR_2_DESC:
Neuro-Electric Force Field 
The neuro-electric field is produced by linking drones' lower brain functions together. This allows healthy drones to greatly increase the rate of recovery for injured drones, by neurologically superimposing the correct functioning of damaged components, guiding the healing process. The same technique is applied to our vessels' systems and repair nanoprobes, increasing repair rates.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_ARMOR_3_DESC:
Multi-Regenerative Force Field 
Interlacing force field networks work to reinforce the hull and absorb a portion of incoming weapons fire. Each force field network can only absorb so much damage before the emitters are overwhelmed, powering down to regenerate. When this occurs, another grid activates to compensate.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_ARMOR_4_DESC:
Dispersion Force Field 
Knowledge assimilated from Species 2546 was used to create quantum fluctuation energy dispersers. Fields of quantum flux distortions surround the vessel during combat, disrupting incoming weapons fire. The affected weapons inflict significantly less damage to our vessel's hull.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_ARMOR_5_DESC:
Triaxilating Force Field 
Networks of triaxilating force field generators are installed throughout our vessel. Triaxilating force fields are more resistant to disruptive energy patterns than previous force fields. Additionally, triaxilating waves can support a higher number of interleaving signals, supporting reinforced field geometries.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_ARMOR_6_DESC:
Hyper-Triaxilated Force Field 
It has been noted that the brains of certain species are capable of applying uncommonly accurate heuristics for the task of field adaptations. Drones formerly of these species should be used to guide force field adaptations and to refine algorithms Collective wide.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_ARMOR_7_DESC:
Multi-Triaxilated Force Field 
Multiple sources of triaxilation are capable of applying uncommonly accurate heuristics for the task of field adaptations. Drones of a specific species should be used to guide force field adaptations and to refine algorithms Collective wide.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_ARMOR_8_DESC:
Neural-Coordinated Triaxilating Field 
Drones from Species 226 and 1657 have the ability to apply uncommonly accurate heuristics when attempting to calculate field geometry adaptations for triaxilating force fields. During combat, their brains are interlinked into a computational subnetwork, improving the speed at which they calculate field geometry adaptations.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_ARMOR_9_DESC:
Quantum-Triaxilating Field 
Species 1701 have successfully managed to apply a quantum field around their ships armour. This Technology now services the Borg Collective.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_ARMY_ASSIMILATION_DESC:
Improved Army Assimilation 
Increases the chance of assimilating enemy armies in ground combat by 50% of the base value.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_AURA_ADAPTABLE_1_DESC:
Adaptive Plexus 
This plexus has been adapted to facilitate the interlinking of regenerating drones brains into an organic computer core. This is achieved using a short range, super high bandwidth comms node, and the large amount of power available to the drone from the vessel's power grid.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_AURA_ADAPTABLE_2_DESC:
Multi-Adaptive Plexus I 
The central plexus links each Borg vessel to every other Borg vessel. This facilitates the fast and efficient transfer of the Collective's knowledge, and real time tactical data. It also allows each vessel's computer to offload processing tasks to other vessels during times of high demand.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_AURA_ADAPTABLE_3_DESC:
Multi-Adaptive Plexus II 
Real time subspace communications allow the rapid communication and processing of data during times of demand, resulting in rapid adaptation.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_AURA_ADAPTABLE_4_DESC:
Multi-Adaptive Plexus III 
Transwarp communications are now possible with a tactical environment allowing processing power from sources as far away as nearby systems to be utilised in the adaptation of new defences.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_CATAPULT_DESC:
Transwarp Aperture 
The formation a stable transwarp stream capable of transporting Borg assets across long distances can be realised via the creation of a new megastructure.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_HULL_1_DESC:
Living Metallic Hull 
This vessel's hull is maintained by an armada of trillions of nanoprobes. The nanoprobes and their raw resources are carried around the vessel through artery like conduits. Deformed sections of hull are manipulated at the atomic level to meld them back into shape.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_HULL_2_DESC:
Duranium PolyWeave Hull 
A hull formed from polywoven duranium. Duranium is common and tough, making the vessel more damage resistant than previous hull patterns. Polyweaving the duranium allows the repair nanoprobes to effectively manipulate and repair the duranium, without compromising the hull's durability.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_HULL_3_DESC:
Paricium Memory Foam Alloy Hull 
This hull is formed from duranium polyweave coated in a protective layer of paricium memory foam. The foam provides excellent shock resistance, while being permeable to the repair nanoprobes to maintain the hull's regenerative ability.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_HULL_3_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Paricium Memory Foam Alloy Hull
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_HULL_4_DESC:
Duranium Buckyball Sheeting 
A hull built from layered duranium buckyball sheets and paricium memory foam. The duranium buckyball sheets provide more kinetic, explosive, and thermal resistance than polyweave. Nanoprobes can rebuild the buckyballs faster than they can repair polyweave threads.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_HULL_5_DESC:
Kelindide-Victurium Composite Hull 
Primary hull layer composed of multiple layers of victurium and kelindide. Kelindide is durable but brittle, and so it's supported by layers of the even tougher victurium, which can't be used in large quantities due to several unacceptable properties.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_HULL_6_DESC:
Tetraburnium Nano-Weave Hull 
A primary hull layer composed of sheets of tetraburnium alloy woven into nanothreads. The nanothread structure adds incredible impact and shock resistance, while being easier for nanoprobes to repair than solid tetraburnium.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_HULL_7_DESC:
Tritanium Mesh Hull 
A tetraburnium nanoweave hull coated in a tritanium mesh. The tritanium mesh is easy to regenerate, and acts as an ablative layer. This helps protect the valuable tetraburnium nanoweave from sustaining damage.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_HULL_8_DESC:
Tritanium Shape Memory Alloy Hull 
Primary hull composed of multiple layers of complementary materials. A fast-regenerating, ablative tritanium mesh is layered over several plates of tritanium shape-memory alloy. The inner layer is formed from incredibly tough tetraburnium nanoweave sheets.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_HULL_8_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Tritanium Shape Memory Alloy Hull
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_HULL_9_DESC:
Victurium Shape Memory Alloy Hull 
Primary hull composed of multiple layers of reinforced materials. A fast-regenerating, ablative Victurium mesh is layered over several plates of tritanium shape-memory alloy. The inner layer is formed from incredibly tough tetraburnium nanoweave sheets.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_HULL_9_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Victurium Shape Memory Alloy Hull
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_IMPROVED_ASSIMILATION_D:
Improved Assimilation Process 
By creating new methods to rapidly distribute nanites in the atmosphere, we can greatly speed up the process of assimilating entire planetary populations into the Collective.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_NANITE_ASSEMBLERS_DESC:
Drone-Hive Housing 
Drone Hive districts can now house more drones.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_SPACE_STRUCTURES_DESC:
Hive-like Space Structures 
Unlocks the construction of the space-based structures such as the Unicomplex, Subcomplex, Defenses, and other structures.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_THRUSTER_1_DESC:
Omni-Directional Impulse 
A network of impulse exhaust thrusters that covers the vessel's hull, allowing movement in any direction without having to turn. The decentralised plasma generator node network means that exhaust plasma is equally available for every exhaust.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_THRUSTER_2_DESC:
Omni-Directional Impulse Array II 
A larger-scale version of the omni-directional impulse drive. Increased quantities of plasma generator nodes, combined with arrays of exhaust nodes, give this engine superior speed and manoeuvrability over the original design.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_THRUSTER_2_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Omni-Directional Impulse Array II
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_THRUSTER_3_DESC:
Omni-Directional Impulse Array III 
Improved specification omni-directional thruster array. The primary enhancement is the fitting of a high-gain impulse exhaust array. The increased efficiency boosts the vessel's acceleration, increasing manoeuvrability and cruising speed.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_THRUSTER_3_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Omni-Directional Impulse Array III
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_THRUSTER_4_DESC:
Omni-Directional Impulse Array IV 
An omni-directional impulse thruster array enhanced with a new reactant, avidyne. Plasma fusion nodes use avidyne to produce hotter, denser plasma exhaust, efficiently increasing the vessel's speed.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_THRUSTER_4_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Omni-Directional Impulse Array IV
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_THRUSTER_5_DESC:
Omni-Directional Impulse Array V 
Avidyne-based omni-directional thruster array enhanced with an avidyne-compatible thruster manifold. The heavy plasma turbulence problems which reduced the efficiency of the original design have been fixed, improving performance characteristics.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_THRUSTER_5_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Omni-Directional Impulse Array V
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_THRUSTER_6_DESC:
Omni-Directional Impulse Array VI 
An advanced omni-directional impulse drive. Immensely powerful artificial graviton cores project a strong, localised, gravimetric tunnel. The tunnel pulls the vessel through it, accelerating it in the direction of travel.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_THRUSTER_6_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Omni-Directional Impulse Array VI
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_THRUSTER_7_DESC:
Omni-Directional Impulse Array VII 
Built from miniaturised assembly segments to form a flexible, compound impulse assembly, this multi-vector thruster manifold provides omni-directional thrust.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_THRUSTER_7_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Omni-Directional Impulse Array VII
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_THRUSTER_8_DESC:
Omni-Directional Paragravitic Impulse Array 
Dedicated matter-antimatter reactors power the omni-directional impulse field. These small reactors will feed the impulse engines with warp plasma, usually reserved for energising the warp coils.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORG_THRUSTER_8_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Omni-Directional Paragravitic Impulse Array
TECH_UNLOCK_BUILDING_CETACEAN_CENTRE_DES:
Cetacean Centre 
A location where the brightest minds from the scientific community and the cetacean oceans can come together to work on challenging scientific breakthroughs in navigation, sensors and much more.
TECH_UNLOCK_BUILDING_INTEL_AGENCY_2_DESC:
Advanced Starfleet Intelligence HQ 
Upgraded offices for Starfleet Intelligence Agency, whose mission goal is to protect Starfleet's interests at home and abroad.
TECH_UNLOCK_BUILDING_INTEL_AGENCY_2_TITL: Unlocks Building: Advanced Starfleet Intelligence HQ
TECH_UNLOCK_BUILDING_INTEL_AGENCY_COE_DE:
Confederation Intelligence HQ 
Headquarters for Confederation Intelligence, whose mission goal is to protect Earth's interests at home and abroad.
TECH_UNLOCK_BUILDING_INTEL_AGENCY_DESC:
Intelligence Agency 
Central offices for the control of internal and external security within the state.
TECH_UNLOCK_BUILDING_INTEL_AGENCY_DOM_DE:
Dominion Security Division 
Central agency for the internal and external affairs of the mighty Dominion. In the name of the Founders.
TECH_UNLOCK_BUILDING_INTEL_AGENCY_S31_DE:
Section 31 Bureau 
Unlocks the property of the mysterious Section 31, who will go to any lengths to protect Federation interests from the shadows.
TECH_UNLOCK_BUILDING_INTEL_AGENCY_STARFL:
Starfleet Intelligence HQ 
Headquarters for Starfleet Intelligence, whose mission goal is to protect Starfleet's interests at home and abroad.
TECH_UNLOCK_CARDASSIAN_EKOOR_DESC:
Ekoor Class 
The Predator of the Cardassian Fleet, hunting in packs to take down larger ships.
TECH_UNLOCK_CARDASSIAN_KULINOR_DESC:
Kulinor Class  
The Kulinor class is a recent introduction within the Cardassian Union's fleet that was made with new advances in technology. They were created secretly by military engineers in order to create a powerful battleship and were known as dark jewels of the Cardassian fleet.
TECH_UNLOCK_CASTLE_CONSTRUCTION_DESC:
Starbase Level V 
The pinnacle of spatial engineering, this starbase is nothing short of a metropolitan anchor in the void. It acts as a central command and control center for entire sectors, capable of fielding vast fleets and coordinating expansive efforts. Its unparalleled resilience and adaptability allow it to project immense power, symbolising dominance and technological might across interstellar distances.
TECH_UNLOCK_CGINDUSTRIAL_DISTRICT_DESC:
Supplies Production 
Industrial districts now increase £ Supplies production by +5% per district.
TECH_UNLOCK_COLONIZATION_BIO_DESC:
Bio-Worlds 
Specially adapted for life in these environments, our race flourishes here. Bio class planets are otherwise inhospitable to non-fluidic life.
TECH_UNLOCK_COLONIZATION_DEMON_DESC:
Demon 
Class Y 'Demon' planets can now be colonised.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_1_DESC:
Ordenador óptico 
Almacenando información en matrices ópticas especialmente diseñadas, los ordenadores ópticos representan un avance significativo en la simulación táctica, aumentando el rendimiento de muchas maneras.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_2_DESC:
Ordenador óptico 
Almacenando información en matrices ópticas especialmente diseñadas, los ordenadores ópticos representan un avance significativo en la simulación táctica, aumentando el rendimiento de muchas maneras.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_3_DESC:
Computadora Duotronic 
Las computadoras de Duotronic fueron diseñadas por el doctor Richard Daystrom de la federación, sucedió la circuitería que utilisó componentes tales como resistencias y transistores.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_4_DESC:
Multitronic Computer 
Multitronic computers utilize very sophisticated technology based on next-level deep neural webs. This allows for a computer that can think and reason, and eventually, even assist in strategy development, ship management and research.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_5_DESC:
Computadora aislada 
Los chips Isolinear cuentan con nanoprocesadores integrados para ayudar en el acceso a la memoria y con una capacidad máxima de 2.15 kiloquads.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_6_DESC:
Paquetes de Gel Bio-Neural 
Los circuitos orgánicos, como los paquetes de gel bio-neural, contenían fibras neurales rodeadas en un gel azul con interfaces metálicas en la parte superior e inferior.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_6_TITLE: Desbloquear Componente: Paquetes de Gel Bio-Neural
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_7_DESC:
Direct Synaptic Connection 
Using advanced cortical implants, every member of the crew can access quickly and inutility every facet of the ship controls at any time and from any location.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_BORG_1_DESC:
Interlinked Computational Array 
These alcoves have been adapted to facilitate the interlinking of regenerating drones' brains into an organic computer core. This is achieved using a short range, super high bandwidth comms node, and the large amount of power available to the drone from the vessel's power grid.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_BORG_2_DESC:
Interlinked Computational Array II 
The central plexus links each Borg vessel to every other Borg vessel. This facilitates the fast and efficient transfer of the Collective's knowledge, and real time tactical data. It also allows each vessel's computer to offload processing tasks to other vessels during times of high demand.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_BORG_2_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Interlinked Computational Array II
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_BORG_3_DESC:
Interlinked Computational Array III 
A new model central plexus, updated to handle all communication between the hive mind and the vessel. This allows marginally faster integration of new instructions and data from the hive mind. A range of incremental improvements boost the vessels general performance.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_BORG_3_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Interlinked Computational Array III
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_BORG_4_DESC:
Interlinked Computational Array IV 
The vessel's main computer core is augmented by a matrix of nanoprocessors embedded throughout its hull. The careful manipulation of nearby EM fields loads instructions into the processors via induction. The tiny EM field generated when processing is used to read the result.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_BORG_4_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Interlinked Computational Array IV
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_BORG_5_DESC:
Interlinked Computational Array V 
Updated computer cores which are able to interface will all nanoprobes present on the vessel. The nanoprobes take over performing simple calculations, allowing the computer core's advanced processing units to handle difficult computations.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_BORG_5_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Interlinked Computational Array V
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_BORG_6_DESC:
Vinculum 
The vinculum is a powerful neural integration processor, creating the order of the hive mind out of the chaos of individual thoughts. Local integration allows rapid reaction to new events. Each vinculum then sends its local hive mind signature to the queen for integration with the Collective.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_BORG_7_DESC:
Interlinked Vinculum 
A vinculum enhanced with the ability to exchange integrated neural patterns with other vinculums, as well as the Queen's unicomplex. This allows a part of the hive mind to be created locally, causing faster adaptations to evolving situations.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_MACHINE_1_DE:
AI Core 
Placing autonomous units' processing nodes into a large network creates a small artificial intelligence network that can be used within our vessels.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_MACHINE_2_DE:
Main Plexus 
Integrating design and processing abilities with a central plexus allows for improved computational abilities.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_MACHINE_3_DE:
Central AI Core 
A central AI core is the heart of a vessel and allows for networked communication between the crew of the vessels.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_MACHINE_4_DE:
High Capacity AI Node 
Larger AI nodes should allow for more automated personnel units to be linked together within our vessels, improving overall efficiency.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_MACHINE_4_TI: Unlocks Component: High Capacity AI Node
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_MACHINE_5_DE:
Distributed AI Network 
By utilising a distributed network where real-time processing is managed directly, whilst secondary routines are shunted off onto low-powered automated personnel units, the efficiency of our vessels' computational power should increase.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_MACHINE_6_DE:
Entangled AI Network 
Following the distributed network, by entangling the artificial intelligence with APU crew, we can ensure a fully real-time computational network.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_MACHINE_7_DE:
Full Entanglement Crew AI Network 
The final step is linking together numerous, automated personnel units in vessels into a fully entangled crew AI network, allowing data to be shared instantaneously, as if that unit had discovered it right then.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_MACHINE_7_TI: Unlocks Component: Full Entanglement Crew AI Network
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_UNDINE_1_DES:
Neural Core 
A neural core is a processing unit that takes the modeled workings of how an organic brain operates and attempts to replicate it.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_UNDINE_2_DES:
Energised Neural Core 
Larger power supplies enable a neural core to undertake more calculations and processes than a regular neural core.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_UNDINE_3_DES:
Organic Computational Node 
Improvements to the growth of organic compounds allows for larger synaptic pathways and processing ability.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_UNDINE_4_DES:
Bio-Pulse Computational Node 
Using pulses of bioenergy, we can simulate the firing of synapses, enabling a short term memory to be created in the organic computational nodes.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_UNDINE_5_DES:
Neural Linked Bioprocessor 
Linking the computational nodes with the crew in an integrated bioprocessor is the next step in organic computational progress.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_UNDINE_6_DES:
Neural Integrated Bioprocessor 
Combining the crew with the neural bioprocessor allows for a vast network to be created across a bioship.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_UNDINE_7_DES:
Bio Energy AI Node 
Combining the bioenergy with an artificial intelligence allows for almost sentient computer processing in real time.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_UNDINE_7_TIT: Unlocks Component: Bio Energy AI Node
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_XINDI_1_DESC:
Xindi Hive Mind Interface 
A linked hive like control interface allows a small crew to power a much bigger ship.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_XINDI_1_TITL: Unlocks Component: Xindi Hive Mind Interface
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_ANTI_CLOAK_SCANNER:
Graviton Field Emitter 
Gravitational Field Emitter can be used to detect micro-shifts in the gravitational field around a cloaked vessel.

Metaphasic Sensor Sweep 
A targetted sweep can pickup energy 'distortions', manifesting themselves most often as refracting visible light energy from surrounding stellar objects very near the cloaked ship's outline.

Tachyon Detection Grid 
A tachyon detection grid was a technique developed as a means of detecting cloaked warships. The grid used active tachyon beams transmitted between different starships or sentry posts to create a tachyon field.

Quantum Beacons 
These beacons were positron-based, and had an output of two hundred gigawatts. The subassembly tolerances were isolated from the emitter algorithms, which was made possible by generating a stable flux between the positronic conductors and renormalizing the tertiary wave functions.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_BORG_REPAIR_1:
Nanite Projector 
Using phased energy beams, nanoprobes are delivered to a vessel's damaged hull segment to begin repair without losing tactical efficiency.

Borg aura devices may be installed every unique Borg ship class, from £ Sphere and upwards.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_BORG_REPAIR_2:
Nanite Projector II 
With the addition of an advanced targeting node, phased energy beams are able to deliver nanoprobes to the precise location of a damaged hull segment. This allows us to repair our vessels quickly and efficiently.

Borg aura devices may be installed every unique Borg ship class, from £ Sphere and upwards.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_BORG_REPAIR_3:
Nanite Projector III 
Triaxilating beams focus on damaged segments of hull in order to repair them rapidly and efficiently. Nearby vessels repair quickly and efficiently.

Borg aura devices may be installed every unique Borg ship class, from £ Sphere and upwards.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_BORG_REPAIR_4:
Nanite Projector IV 
Nanite fields can be projected over large areas of a damaged hull in order to prepare damaged segments. Nearby vessels repair quickly and efficiently.

Borg aura devices may be installed every unique Borg ship class, from £ Sphere and upwards.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_BORG_TRACTOR_:
Borg Tractor Beam 
A powerful tractor beam utilised by the Borg. It can hold even large ships at bay and also be used in warp.

Borg aura devices may be installed every unique Borg ship class, from £ Sphere and upwards.

Borg Cutting Beam 
The addition of a cutting beam to the already deadly Borg tractor beam allows the Borg to carve held enemy ships into pieces.

Borg aura devices may be installed on every unique Borg ship class, from £ Sphere and upwards.

Borg Coherent Cutting Beam 
With more power directed at the cutting beam, the Borg can literally carve enemy fleets into pieces.

Borg aura devices may be installed on every unique Borg ship class, from £ Sphere and upwards.
Unlocks Component: Borg Coherent Cutting Beam

Borg Focused Cutting Beam 
With multiple emitters allowing the cutting beam to be focused on particularly hardened sections, the Borg can literally carve enemy fleets into pieces.

Borg aura devices may be installed on every unique Borg ship class, from £ Sphere and upwards.
Unlocks Component: Borg Focused Cutting Beam

Borg Resonance Cutting Beam 
Resonance technology allows further focus from the beams, giving the Borg more power to cut up anyone who resists.

Borg aura devices may be installed on every unique Borg ship class, from £ Sphere and upwards.
Unlocks Component: Borg Resonance Cutting Beam
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_BRIDGE_1_DESC:
Battle Bridge 
Redundant command centre for ship activities. It may also be used to command the separate part of an otherwise combined vessel.

Support aura devices may only be installed on £ Battleship class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_BRIDGE_2_DESC:
Fleet Battle Bridge 
An enhanced command centre with communication and control systems enabling superior command over a fleet.

Support aura devices may only be installed on £ Battleship class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_BRIDGE_3_DESC:
Holographic Battle Bridge 
A superior command bridge with holographic displays and communications for full command and control over a large fleet.

Support aura devices may only be installed on £ Battleship class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_DEFENSE_BATTL:
Exotic Matter 
This unique weapon does not cause actual damage to enemy ships - instead, it infuses their fields with exotic matter, causing them to act unreliably.

This device disrupts the positive auras of enemy ships, rendering them useless in an area around the source.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_DEFENSE_CRUIS:
Anti-Viral Defense 
This dedicated and independent computer module would monitor your ship's hardware and software in real time for any intrusions and interferences from a wide variety of possible enemy devices.

This device makes the ship immune to all form of hostile debuff auras. It may only be installed on £ Cruiser class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_DEFENSE_DESTR:
Inertial Nullifier 
This unique device is more than a typical inertial damper. Instead, it's a complex array of backup inertial control device spread out across the ship and linked to highly calibrated gyroscopes. This system allows the ship to resist almost every type of kinetic and spatial form of attack or hindrance.

This device makes the ship immune to all form of hostile snare auras. It may only be installed on £ Destroyer class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_GORN_JAMMER_1:
Gorn Mk. II Optical Jammer 
A simply jamming technique, further enhanced by the Gorn, this reflects optical sensors thus rendering vessels hard to detect or target.
Unlocks Component: Gorn Mk. II Optical Jammer
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_GORN_JAMMER_2:
Gorn Mk. III Gravimetric Jammer 
Gravimetric particles are used to surround a vessel, making it extremely difficult to target accurately.
Unlocks Component: Gorn Mk. III Gravimetric Jammer
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_GORN_JAMMER_3:
Gorn Mk. IV Subspace Jammer 
Unique to the Gorn, the subspace jammer masks a vessels energy signature within a subspace field, making it extremely difficult to detect.
Unlocks Component: Gorn Mk. IV Subspace Jammer
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_GORN_JAMMER_4:
Gorn Mk. V Holographic Spoofing Jammer 
Unique to the Gorn, the Holographical Spoofing Jammer creates hard light imagery to fool even the most detailed sensors.
Unlocks Component: Gorn Mk. V Holographic Spoofing Jammer
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_HOLOGRAPHIC_D:
Holographic Ship Projector 
A combination of visual projectors, sensor modifications, and replicator technologies.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_JAMMER_1_DESC:
Signal Jammer 
This basic signal jammer might be based on pre-warp technology, but it is still quite effective. It floods the battlefield with white noise on all electromagnetic spectrum frequencies. The result drastically reduces the accuracy of enemy weapons.

Debuff aura devices may only be installed on £ Cruiser class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_JAMMER_2_DESC:
Gravimetric Signal Jammer 
Utilising powerful graviton particles in a high powered configuration allows us to use them in our jamming technology used by our vessels.

Debuff aura devices may only be installed on £ Cruiser class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_JAMMER_3_DESC:
Verteron Overload Jammer 
Utilising powerful verteron particles in a high powered configuration allows us to use them in our jamming technology used by our vessels.

Debuff aura devices may only be installed on £ Cruiser class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_MINE_1_DESC:
Nuclear Explosives 
Primitive, fissionable, pre-warp nuclear warheads put to use as an orbital explosive.

Every day, the minefield causes an average of between 50 and 100 points of £ Damage to all enemy ships in range. Has a base accuracy value of 50%, and smaller, more agile ships have a higher chance to evade this damage.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_MINE_2_DESC:
Minas autorreplicables 
Nuestros investigadores han desarrollado una nueva mina capaz de replicarse. Cada mina tiene inicialmente solamente 1/65 del material almacenado en ellos para una sola mina de reemplazo, pero su mente-colmena puede enlazar y compartir recursos
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_REPAIR_1_DESC:
Field Repair Depot 
A component that, when installed on a battleship's bridge, will function as a field repair depot for nearby ships.

Support aura devices may only be installed on £ Battleship class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_REPAIR_1_TITL: Desbloquear Componente: Módulo de soporte de reparación de la flota
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_REPAIR_2_DESC:
Mobile Repair Depot 
A component, when installed on a battleship's bridge, will function as a repair depot for nearby ships.

Support aura devices may only be installed on £ Battleship class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_REPAIR_2_TITL: Desbloquear Componente: Módulo de soporte de reparación de la flota
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_REPAIR_3_DESC:
Nano-Repair Bots Injectors 
Nano-repair bot pods can be injected directly over the hull of nearby ships, thus increasing the repair rate.

Support aura devices may only be installed on £ Battleship class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_SHIELD_1_DESC:
Extended Shields 
Allows the battleship's shield emitters to project a shield at a greater distance from the ship to be used to help re-energize the gravitons in other friendly ships' shields if the frequencies match.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_SHIELD_2_DESC:
Rotating Extended Shields 
Enhancements to the battleship's shield emitters' modulation enables better re-energization of allied ships' shields.

Support aura devices may only be installed on £ Battleship class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_SHIELD_3_DESC:
Multi-Adaptive Shields 
Enhancements to the battleship's shield emitters' modulation enables better re-energization of allied ships shields.

Support aura devices may only be installed on £ Battleship class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_SHIELD_DRAIN_:
Aceton Assimilator 
These devices can leech energy from nearby vessels, leaving them moribund and derelict.

Debuff aura devices may only be installed on £ Cruiser class starships.

Miniaturised Aceton Assimilator Mk. II 
These devices can leech energy from nearby vessels, leaving them moribund and derelict.

Debuff aura devices may only be installed on £ Cruiser class starships.

Comatizer Mk. III Assimilator 
A cunning improvement over the Aceton, the Comatizer can leach even more energy from the shields of nearby vessels.

Debuff aura devices may only be installed on £ Cruiser class starships.
Unlocks Component: Comatizer Mk. III Assimilator
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_SNARE_1_DESC:
Warp Inhibitor 
This system delays the ability of opposing vessels to easily engage their warp drives.

Snare aura devices may only be installed on £ Destroyer class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_SNARE_2_DESC:
Isolytic Subspace Weapon 
A range of directed isolytic energy weaponry with great effect on subspace which is known for causing subspace tears. The weapons either fire energy pulses or beams of subspace wavelengths, or impact subspace directly causing sub-spacial vibrations.

Snare aura devices may only be installed on £ Destroyer class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_SNARE_3_DESC:
Temporal Shockwave Snare 
By creating an chronometric burst in normal space, we can tear a hole in space-time rendering warp drives inoperable for a period of time.

Snare aura devices may only be installed on £ Destroyer class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_SNARE_4_DESC:
Temporal Shockwave Snare 
The isolytic tears in subspace can now be detonated, causing a temporal shock wave which will disable warp drives for a large period of time.

Snare aura devices may only be installed on £ Destroyer class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_SWEEPER_DESC:
Mine Sweeper 
A powerful suite of short-range, high-resolution sensors, this device allows the ship to detect even stealthed mines before it's too late.

This device gives the ship total immunity from mine damage.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_THOLIAN_1_DES:
Tholian Web 
The tholian web is composed of a series of energy filaments which are generated in a web pattern around a target vessel.

Tholian unique aura devices may be installed on three ship classes: £ Destroyer, £ Cruiser and £ Battleship.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_THOLIAN_2_DES:
Tholian Web Spinner 
This module allows the creation of the energy filaments used in the Tholian Web.

Tholian unique aura devices may be installed on three ship classes: £ Destroyer, £ Cruiser and £ Battleship.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_THOLIAN_3_DES:
Tholian Web Spinner II 
This module allows the creation of the energy filaments used in the Tholian Web.

Tholian unique aura devices may be installed on three ship classes: £ Destroyer, £ Cruiser and £ Battleship.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_THOLIAN_3_TIT: Unlocks Component: Tholian Web Spinner II
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_THOLIAN_4_DES:
Super-Luminal Web Spinner 
This module allows the creation of the energy filaments used in the Tholian Web.

Tholian unique aura devices may be installed on three ship classes: £ Destroyer, £ Cruiser and £ Battleship.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_TRACTOR_1_DES:
Grappler 
The grappler fires a clawed magnetic Grappler attached to a heavy nanopolymer tow cable that can grapple objects in space.

Snare aura devices may only be installed on £ Destroyer class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_TRACTOR_2_DES:
Tractor Beam 
A collimated beam of gravitons is used to hold various objects, anything from space debris to a ship.

Snare aura devices may only be installed on £ Destroyer class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_TRACTOR_3_DES:
Multiphase Tractor Beam 
In order to hold larger objects or non-solid objects, the tractor beam is enhanced with high-surge energy pulses, enabling it to move massive objects, such as stellar core fragments.

Snare aura devices may only be installed on £ Destroyer class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_AURA_TRACTOR_4_DES:
Subspace Tractor Beam 
Remodulating the tractor beams to account for subspace interference allows these tractor beams to hold objects through shields and other obstacles.

Snare aura devices may only be installed on £ Destroyer class starships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_BAJORAN_CREW_DESC:
Bajoran 
This crew complement is predominantly staffed by Bajoran personnel.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_BORG_EPS_1_DESC:
EPS Conduit 
EPS conduits take small amounts of plasma and redirect it throughout the ship for use in powering other systems.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_BORG_EPS_2_DESC:
EPS Manifold 
The warp reactor and impulse drive systems are looped together. This provides an additional source of plasma energy for systems use.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_BORG_EPS_3_DESC:
EPS Relay 
The warp reactor and impulse drive systems are looped together. This provides an additional source of plasma energy for systems use.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_BORG_EPS_4_DESC:
EPS Matrix 
With the EPS matrix linked to every system tying them directly in to warp power, systems around the ship gain additional power.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_BORG_EPS_5_DESC:
Warp Plasma Inflused EPS Relay 
With the EPS relay infused with warp plasma, systems around the ship gain additional power.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_BORG_EPS_5_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Warp Plasma Inflused EPS Relay
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CARDASSIAN_CREW_DE:
Cardassian 
This crew complement is predominantly staffed by Cardassian personnel.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CHRONOTON_SHIELDIN:
Chroniton Shielding 
Chroniton Shielding allows a vessel to phase themselves out of time providing near impenetrable shield.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CONSOLE_BACKUP_DES:
Emergency Backup Systems 
The loss of main power can be catastrophic to a starship without the redundancy of emergency backup systems. These allow a stricken vessel the chance to withdraw and fight another day.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CONSOLE_COIL_1_DES:
Backup Warp Coils 
A pair of backup warp coils, ready and primed to enable a quick escape.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CONSOLE_COIL_2_DES:
Auxilliary Warp Coils 
Auxillary warp coils are tied in to the main system, ready to be brought online at a moments notice in case of rapid tactical relocation.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CONSOLE_COIL_DESC:
Backup Warp Coils 
A pair of backup warp coils, ready and primed to enable a quick escape.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CONSOLE_DERVISH_DE:
Dervish Device 
A console component that uses a sophisticated set of mono-spectrum sub-tools.

Console devices may be installed on a unique slot available only on large standard military ships. It can be found on the £ Destroyer class and upwards.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CONSOLE_ENGINEERIN:
Main Engineering Console 
A console component that can be installed on our spaceship bridge. This one is designed to control engineering and will allow our crew to greatly reinforce the structure of the ship's structural integrity field.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CONSOLE_FED_CLOAK_:
Interphase Cloaking Generator 
Light diffusion, and sensor blocking, is further augmented by chroniton particle generation.

Console devices may be installed on a unique slot available only on large standard military ships. It can be found on the £ Destroyer class and upwards.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CONSOLE_FIRE_RARE_:
Temporal Spitfire 
Cycling temporal energy through the weapons banks drastically increases the rate of cooling available, resulting in a more rapid rate of fire.

Console devices may be installed on a unique slot available only on large standard military ships. It can be found on the £ Destroyer class and upwards.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CONSOLE_GENERIC_CL:
Early Cloak 
A use of metamaterials, remote-hacking, and radar distortion, that enable one to mask the visual and remote perception of an object.

Spatial Displacement Cloak 
By shifting our ships slightly out of phase with the normal universe, we can shift our vessels to new positions and then reemerge. This will be extremely difficult for our enemies to detect.

Temporal Energy Cloak 
An exceedingly strong cloaking device using chronitons to mask a vessel.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CONSOLE_KDF_CLOAK_:
Invisibility Barrier 
Hiding our vessels has long been a tactician's dream. Our new approach is based on metamaterials, artificial arrangements of resonators with unusual electromagnetic properties which can redirect light.

Raider Prototype Cloaking 
The dampening of external emissions and storage of all waste heat will be required to hide our vessels from sensors.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CONSOLE_LAB_3_DESC:
Stellar Cartography 
Scientific facility with a focus on charting stars and planets. Real-time sensor arrays provide detail on nearby stars, planets, nebulae, and other stellar bodies, allowing ships to investigate anomalies with increased success.

Lab modules may only be placed on dedicated £ Science ships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CONSOLE_LAB_4_DESC:
Astrometrics Lab 
Scientific facility with the ability to comprehensively analyse space-time on a galactic scale. Large holographic displays can render entire sectors in real-time.

Lab modules may only be placed on dedicated £ Science ships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CONSOLE_LAB_DESC:
Multipurpose Labs 
An additional, basic, mobile science lab, designed to deal with a variety of spatial phenomena encountered in deep space.

Lab modules may only be placed on dedicated £ Science ships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CONSOLE_ROM_CLOAK_:
Holographic Chameleon 
Holoemitters can hide the true capabilities and shape of our vessels, sowing discord in the opponents ranks.

Multiphasic Cloaking 
Multiphasic sensor masking allows for the masking of many emissions from different sources, thus rendering vessels harder to detect.

Dual Cloaking Generator 
By tying in a large enough power generator with dual shield and cloaking devices, it should be possible to maintain deflector shields whilst cloaked.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CONSOLE_SCIENCE_DE:
Science Console 
A console component that can be installed on our spaceship bridge. This one is scientific in nature and will provide our ships with increased evasion, tracking, and targeting.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CONSOLE_SPEED_DESC:
Temporal Rewinder 
A console, based on cutting-edge temporal research, it uses a closed temporal loop to create duplicates of our starships for a short period of times.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CONSOLE_TACTICAL_D:
Tactical Console 
A console component that can be installed on our spaceship bridge. This one is tactical in nature and will allow our crew to safely divert energy to increase the maximum damage of our weapons systems.
