Augment 
Genetically augmented crew superior in virtually all ways.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CREW_AUGMENT_2_DES:
Advanced Augment Crew 
Advanced augmentations providing a crew that can work quicker, smarter and more deadly.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CREW_CLONE_DESC:
Clone 
Cloned crews staff this vessel, allowing large numbers of the crew to be unskilled clones.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CREW_CYBERNETIC_DE:
Cybernetic 
Cybernetic enhancements improve the performance of the regular crew.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CREW_EXOCOMP_DESC:
Exocomp 
Exocomp companions supplement the regular crew.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CREW_HOLO_DESC:
Holographic 
Holographic crew personnel are added via strategically placed holoemitters throughout the ship.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CREW_HUNTER_DESC:
Hunter 
Trained to hunt prey, these hunters are expert raiders.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CREW_HUSNOCK_DESC:
Husnock 
The violent and brutal Husnock crew this vessel.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CREW_KAZON_DESC:
Kazon 
The aggressive and brutal Kazon make ineffectual explorers, but great warriors.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CREW_KOBALI_DESC:
Kobali 
Kobali crews are made up from the dead of other races.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CREW_MACO_DESC:
MACO 
Military Assault Command Operations are an elite part of the United Earth Military, with specialist training for combat tactics and strategies.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CREW_SHELIAK_DESC:
Sheliak 
The stoic R-3 lifeforms known as Sheliak crew this vessel.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CREW_TELLARITE_DES:
Tellarite 
Filled with ornery Tellarites, these crews are stubborn and stoic.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CREW_VOTH_DESC:
Voth 
Voth crews ensure that Doctrine is adhered to across the quadrant.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CREW_VULCAN_DESC:
Vulcan 
The Vulcan crews are trained at the Vulcan Science Academy.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_CREW_XINDI_DESC:
Xindi 
Made up of the five Xindi species, these vessels are multicultural.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_FEDERATION_CREW_DE:
Federation 
This crew complement is predominantly staffed by Federation personnel.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_FERENGI_CASINO_DES:
Mobile Casino 
High rollers from many worlds enjoy visits to these luxurious mobile casinos that traverse the stars away from any prying eyes.

Mobile Casinos produce a small amount of £ latinum, and remember: the House always wins.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_INF_SPAWNER_DESC:
Infestation Spawner 
An additional attachment to Undine stations that allow them to spawn the dangerous Infestation Class Ships.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_KLINGON_CREW_DESC:
Klingon 
This crew complement is predominantly staffed by Klingon personnel.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_PROSPECTING_BAY_DE:
Prospecting Bay 
A prospecting bay allows the processing of any small minerals or materials that the construction vessel may come across.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_ROMULAN_CREW_2_DES:
Tal Shiar Operatives 
Trained to an extremely high standard, and extremely self sufficient, Tal Shiar operatives put the needs of Romulus above all else.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_ROMULAN_CREW_3_DES:
Reman Crew 
Raised in the dark mines of Remus, these Remans are extremely loyal and dedicated.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_ROMULAN_CREW_4_DES:
Telepathic Control 
Vessels can be controlled over vast distances via telepathic link.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_ROMULAN_CREW_DESC:
Romulan 
This crew complement is predominantly staffed by Romulan personnel.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_SENSOR_1_DESC:
Optical Sensor Array 
Optical telescopes are tried and true pre-warp technology that has allowed us to explore the universe even before we launched our very first space ship. Modern optical sensors are leaps and bounds ahead of those ancient telescopes, but it is still the continuation of a proud tradition.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_SENSOR_2_DESC:
Gravitic Sensor Array 
These sensors have been tuned to look for any gravitational changes in space, such as those produced by the presence of a starship.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_SENSOR_3_DESC:
Tachyon Sensors 
Advanced sensors that rely on rotating tachyon beams to detect ship movements even at extreme distances.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_SENSOR_4_DESC:
Trans-Spectral Sensors 
Research into advanced subspace physics has made it possible to detect tiny ripples which cause slight variability in subspace.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_SHIP_AUTOMATION_DE:
Ship Automation Centre 
Added layers of automation that increase efficiency and decreases resource consumption on all ships with it installed.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_UTILITY_AUX_CREW_2:
Crew Quarters II 
Common crew bunks, usually stacked four to a room. Facilities are shared by each bunkroom.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_UTILITY_AUX_EMITTE:
Shield Emitter 
A utility device that generates large field of gravitons for sustained periods of time. These new emitters will increase the regeneration process of our shields.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_UTILITY_LARGE_TRAC:
Cetacean Ops 
Cetacean Ops was a facility aboard Starfleet starships in the late 24th century. They generally contained an aquarium, so as to simulate the natural habitat of cetaceans allowing them to work with the scientists and navigators onboard the ship.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMPONENT_UTILITY_REACTOR_PE:
PXK Pergium Reactor 
Using rare refined Pergium, this reactor can supply massive amounts of supplementary power when a vessel requires it.
TECH_UNLOCK_CONSOLE_AGONY_DESC:
Agony Booths 
Agony booths are installed within the vessel, providing a way to dispose of traitorous crew or lacklustre crew.
TECH_UNLOCK_CONSOLE_BACKUP_2_DESC:
Dicyclic Life Support System 
A redundant life support system can be built into the vessel, increasing survivability when heavily damaged.

Increases the likelihood of a heavily damaged vessel successfully withdrawing from battle.
TECH_UNLOCK_CONSOLE_BACKUP_2_TITLE: Unlocks Console: Dicyclic Life Support System
TECH_UNLOCK_CONSOLE_BACKUP_3_DESC:
Tricyclic Life Support Systems 
Triple redundant life support systems offer increased survivability to the crew of a stricken vessel.

Increases the likelihood of a heavily damaged vessel successfully withdrawing from battle.
TECH_UNLOCK_CONSOLE_BACKUP_3_TITLE: Unlocks Console: Tricyclic Life Support Systems
TECH_UNLOCK_CONSOLE_BACKUP_4_DESC:
Emergency Command Hologram 
In the event of total crew loss or incapacitation, the emergency command hologram can activate and take over the running of the vessel, ensuring optimum chance of survival or retrieval.

Increases the likelihood of a heavily damaged vessel successfully withdrawing from battle.
TECH_UNLOCK_CONSOLE_ENGINEERING_2_DESC:
Engineering Station II 
A console component that can be installed on our spaceship bridge. This one is designed to control engineering and will allow our crew to greatly reinforce the structure of the ship's structural integrity field.
TECH_UNLOCK_CONSOLE_ENGINEERING_DESC:
Main Engineering Console

TECH_UNLOCK_CONSOLE_HULL_DESC:

TECH_UNLOCK_CONSOLE_PRECOG_DESC:
Precognition Chamber 
A console component that takes into account new algorithms to predict an enemy ships movement.

Console devices may be installed on a unique slot available only on large standard military ships. It can be found on the £ Destroyer class and upwards.
TECH_UNLOCK_CONSOLE_SENSOR_DESC:
Subspace Differential Sensor Suite 
Detecting the minute changes in subspace and the differential allows for unique targeting opportunities.
TECH_UNLOCK_CONSOLE_SENSOR_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Subspace Differential Sensor Suite
TECH_UNLOCK_CONSOLE_TACTICAL_DESC:
Tactical Console

TECH_UNLOCK_CONSOLE_TRACKING_DESC:
Exographic Targeting Sensor 
The exographic targeting sensor can target objects that are hidden behind opaque barriers.

Console devices may be installed on a unique slot available only on large standard military ships. It can be found on the £ Destroyer class and upwards.
TECH_UNLOCK_CONSOLE_WEAPON_RANGE_DESC:
High-Focusing Time-Crystal Array 
This targeting array utilises time-crystals in order to enable precision targeting.

Console devices may be installed on a unique slot available only on large, standard military ships. It can be found on the £ Destroyer class and upwards.
TECH_UNLOCK_CPM_CPM_DISTRICT_DESC:
CPM 
CPM districts now produce more £ CPMs.
TECH_UNLOCK_CREATE_FEDERATION_DESC:
Formulario de la Federación 
Nos permite formar una Federación con otros Imperios
TECH_UNLOCK_CREATE_FEDERATION_TITLE: Desbloquea Diplomacia: Formulario de la Federación
TECH_UNLOCK_CREW_AI_DESC:
AI Control 
A central AI controls the crew.
TECH_UNLOCK_CREW_MILITARY_DISTRICT_MAX_D:
Crew 
Administrative districts now recruit more £ Crew.
TECH_UNLOCK_CRIME_MILITARY_DISTRICT_DESC:
Crime 
The Administrative district/Hive Foci now reduces £ Crime.
TECH_UNLOCK_CUSTOM_ARTIFICIAL_GRAVITY_DE:
Artificial Gravity 
The generation of an artificial gravity field onboard our vessels allows for regular onboard activity without the need of specialised equipment.
TECH_UNLOCK_CUSTOM_ASSAULT_ARMIES_DESC:
Assault Armies 
The creation of a military body that is capable of traversing space and assaulting other planets requires a substantial investment in training and new research.
TECH_UNLOCK_CUSTOM_BUREAU_COLONIAL_DESC:
Colonial Management 
The management of more than one planetary body requires new communications and governance protocols to be developed to deal with the vast distances involved.
TECH_UNLOCK_CUSTOM_CLONE_ARMIES_DESC:
Clone Armies 
Vat-grown clones that reach adulthood in a matter of months. With a natural lifespan of less than a decade, their lack of personal initiative is deemed an acceptable trade-off for their total obedience to officers.
TECH_UNLOCK_CUSTOM_OFFWORLD_CONSTRUCTION:
Offworld Construction 
The construction of facilities offworld requires a substantial investment in resources and development.
TECH_UNLOCK_DECISION_ARTIFACT_1_DESC:
Permanent Exhibitions 
Allows the permanent exhibition of certain minor artifacts on worlds.
TECH_UNLOCK_DECISION_ARTIFACT_2_DESC:
Artifact Showcase and Trading 
Allows minor artifact showcases and trading.
TECH_UNLOCK_DECISION_ARTIFACT_2_TITLE: Unlocks Decision: Artifact Showcase and Trading
TECH_UNLOCK_DECISION_BIGGER_ASTEROID_DES:
Hollowed Asteroid 
Hollowing out the internal sections of asteroids could improve the amount of livable space for our larger habitats.
TECH_UNLOCK_DECISION_EXTRACT_METALS_DESC:
Nanite Metal Extraction 
Metals can be extracted from the crust and mantle of a planet via nanites.
TECH_UNLOCK_DECISION_POP_MANAGEMENT_DESC:
Population Management 
The management of vast bodies of the population is a monumental task that requires an iron will.
TECH_UNLOCK_DEFENCE_FORCEFIELD_2_DESC:
Form-fitting Forcefields 
Generated forcefields that exist just above the surface of the hull, protecting it from near energy bursts and weapon damage.
TECH_UNLOCK_DEFENSE_FORCEFIELD_3_DESC:
Advanced Forcefields 
Powerful forcefields cover sections of the ship, providing additional defence against the stresses of space.
TECH_UNLOCK_DEFENSE_FORCEFIELD_4_DESC:
Structural Integrity Field 
A powerful energy field that covers the interior sections of the vessel, providing a source of energy to bolster the hull against the stresses of space combat.
TECH_UNLOCK_DEFENSE_FORCEFIELD_5_DESC:
Rotating Structural Integrity Field 
The rotating frequencies of the structural integrity field grant additional protection from the stresses of combat.
TECH_UNLOCK_DEFENSE_FORCEFIELD_5_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Rotating Structural Integrity Field
TECH_UNLOCK_DEFENSE_FORCEFIELD_6_DESC:
Dynamic Structural Integrity Field 
The structural integrity field can now be shifted across the vessel, providing support in areas that require it most.
TECH_UNLOCK_DEFENSE_FORCEFIELD_6_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Dynamic Structural Integrity Field
TECH_UNLOCK_DEFENSE_POLARIZED_2_DESC:
Revestimiento de casco polarizado 
A través de la aplicación de un campo electromagnético al casco del barco, la integridad estructural se puede aumentar perceptiblemente, protegiendo la nave estelar de fuego de las armas enemigas.
TECH_UNLOCK_DEFENSE_POLARIZED_2_TITLE: Desbloquear Componente: Revestimiento de casco polarizado
TECH_UNLOCK_DEFENSE_POLARIZED_3_DESC:
Polarised Hull Plating Relay

Casco de titanio 
Materiales espaciales para las primeras verdaderas naves espaciales de nuestros tiempos.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_2_DESC:
Tritanium Hull 
Applying this new, lighter material to our ships' hulls would make our ships even more durable.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_3_DESC:
Tritanium-Magnesite Hull 
Magnesite is an oxide form of magnesium, one of the lightest metals we have discovered. Its light weight, high toughness, and machinability make it an ideal choice for starship hulls.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_4A_DESC:
Electro-Ceramic Hull 
A light material component that can be used on the hull to increase the manoeuvrability of our starships, but due to the lightness of the material it will come at a cost of reduced armour.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_4B_DESC:
Kelindide-Magnesite Hull 
By weaving magnesite through the kelindide alloy hull, we have created an even stronger armour that increases the durability of our ships.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_4C_DESC:
Duranium-Magnesite Hull 
By weaving magnesite through the duranium alloy hull, we have created an even stronger hull that increases the durability of our ships.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_4D_DESC:
Modular Duranium Plating Hull 
Prefabricated hull sections can be combined efficiently and cost effectively. Whilst not strong, nor nimble, the vessels made from these readily available materials are extremely cost effective to operate.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_4D_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Modular Duranium Plating Hull
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_5A_DESC:
Paricium Hull 
A ceramic alloy, often mixed with Talgonite, used in hull construction. It is light, but comes at the cost of reduced armour effectiveness.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_5B_DESC:
Reflective Kelindide Sheeting 
Reflective sheeting on this kelindide based hull provides a slight increase to the armour of the hull.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_5C_DESC:
Duranium Weave Hull 
By weaving these two heavy metallic alloys together we have the basis of an even stronger hull that increases the durability of our ships.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_5D_DESC:
Parametallic Magnesite Hull 
If we want to make our starships more durable, we could investigate additional materials that can be placed on the external layers of our starship hulls. By combining different types of materials together, we have come up with another type of armor plating. This new type of alloy will provide the additional protection needed against weapon fire or hazardous materials a starship's hull could encounter.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_6A_DESC:
Magnesite-Paricium Hull 
A stronger metallic alloy than tritanium that can be applied to our starship hull for an even further increase in the durability of our ships' hulls.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_6B_DESC:
Dispersive Kelindide Sheeting 
Improves to the kelindide sheet now disperse impacts rather than reflecting them, providing an increase to the armour rating of the ship.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_6C_DESC:
Duranium-Victurium Hull 
The implementation of Duranium alloy on our starships have been a monumental success. Now, we just discovered a new metal alloy called Victurium, seemingly just as strong as Duranium and if we combine these two metallic alloys together, we will have the basis of an even stronger hull that further increases the durability of our ships' hulls.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_6D_DESC:
Non-Reactive Victurium Hull 
The creation of a hull that is simply non-reactive to energy bursts is a very cost-effective way of providing protection for a vessel.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_7A_DESC:
Magnesite-Monotanium Hull 
Monotanium is a metallic alloy that will probably be the lightest type of material we could possibly ever discover. While an extremely light armor component, it will still increases durability.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_7B_DESC:
Reactive Kelindide Sheeting 
Blast plates under the kelindide sheeting allow for reactive armour improving the armour rating of the ship.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_7C_DESC:
Duranium Composite Sheeting 
Duranium is an extremely strong metal that is used by many species for starship hulls due to its suitability as armor. It is heavy though, potentially increasing a ship's mass and making it less maneuverable.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_7D_DESC:
Duranide Alloy Hull 
Polyduranide is a metallic material used for construction purposes. It is cheap and easy to mass produce via machinery.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_8A_DESC:
Light Magnesite-Tritanium Hull 
Constructed by large amounts of magnesite treated with tritanium, this alloy is light but at the cost of reduced armour effectiveness.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_8B_DESC:
Heavy Kelindide-Tetraburnium Hull 
The creation of a heavy Kelindide-tetraburnium alloy that is resistant to energy weapons drastically improves the armour rating of a ship.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_8C_DESC:
PolyDuranium Weave Hull 
Another metallic alloy has been classified and this one we are calling PolyDuranium Weave. Going along the branch of our Duranium and Duranium-Victurium type alloys, this alloy is even stronger than those, providing further increases to the durability of our ships' hulls.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_8D_DESC:
Plasticised Tritanium Mesh Hull 
Treating tritanium with cheap, but strong, plastics allows us to create an extremely inexpensive hull material with the strength of tritanium.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_8D_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Plasticised Tritanium Mesh Hull
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_9A_DESC:
Light Trititanium-Victurium Hull 
Constructed by large amounts of combined Trititanium-Victurium, this alloy is light but at the cost of reduced armour effectiveness.
TECH_UNLOCK_HULL_9B_DESC:
Heavy Tetraburnium-Victurium Hull 
The creation of a heavy Tetraburnium-Victurium alloy that is resistant to energy weapons drastically improves the armour rating of a ship.

TECH_UNLOCK_LINE_ANTIMATTER_PRINCIPLES_D:
Antimatter 
The principles of antimatter weapons are to utilise devices using antimatter as a power source, propellant, or an explosive.
TECH_UNLOCK_LINE_DISRUPTOR_PRINCIPLES_DE:
Disruptor 
The basic principles of disruptor technology are that disruptors cause damage by exciting the molecular bonds of targets to such great extents that those bonds are weakened, and/or broken, by the energies emitted, which often manifest as explosive force.
TECH_UNLOCK_LINE_PHASER_PRINCIPLES_DESC:
Phaser

TECH_UNLOCK_LINE_PLASMAWARHEAD_PRINCIPLE:

TECH_UNLOCK_LINE_PLASMA_PRINCIPLES_DESC:

TECH_UNLOCK_LINE_TETRYON_PRINCIPLES_DESC:
Tetryon 
A tetryon is a subatomic particle that can only exist in subspace environments. Since these particles are a property of subspace, they become highly energetic and unstable when they are extruded into normal space, which can occur by both natural and artificial means, such as with tetryonic weapons.

TECH_UNLOCK_MECH_MINING_ERRORFIX_DESC:
Mining 
As empires enter the space age, mining of raw materials becomes more and more automated.

Medical Breakthrough 
The impact of this specific plague will be reduced or eliminated in the future thanks to breakthroughs in medical science.
TECH_UNLOCK_MEGASTRUCTURE_ARGUS_DESC:
Argus Array 
A massive sensor array, the Argus Array consists of eighteen hexagonal subspace antennae clusters, each powered by an individual fusion reactor, and all regulated from a central computer. It is capable of collecting detailed images of objects many light years away.
TECH_UNLOCK_MEGASTRUCTURE_BORG_CONDUIT_D:
Transwarp Conduit 
A massive transwarp gateway can be constructed, linking to any other gateway in the galaxy allowing for almost instantaneous transit.
TECH_UNLOCK_MEGASTRUCTURE_DAYSTROM_DESC:
Daystrom Station 
Daystrom Station was a Federation space station that served as a high-security black site of the Daystrom Institute.
TECH_UNLOCK_MEGASTRUCTURE_FED_MUSEUM_DES:
Starfleet Historical Museum 
Older Starfleet designs can be reactivated from within the Starfleet Historical Museum. Build a museum and contact them to adjust your designs.
TECH_UNLOCK_MEGASTRUCTURE_GALACTIC_FORUM:
Galactic Forum 
The Galactic Forum is now available for construction. This large base will dramatically increase your relations with other races.
TECH_UNLOCK_MEGASTRUCTURE_KDF_MUSEUM_DES:
Klingon War Museum 
Older Klingon ship designs can be reactivated from within the Historical Museum. If we build a museum and contact them, we can adjust our designs.
TECH_UNLOCK_MEGASTRUCTURE_MIDAS_DESC:
MIDAS Array 
Capable of creating subspace wormholes that allow communications over vast distances, the MIDAS array will allow a much greater amount of naval capacity, due to the improved communication.
TECH_UNLOCK_MEGASTRUCTURE_PARTICLE_DESC:
Particle Fountain 
Designed to lift large amounts of material directly from a planetary surface, the particle stream is also a fantastic source of information and a research tool for engineering works.
TECH_UNLOCK_MEGASTRUCTURE_ROM_MUSEUM_DES:
Praetorian Naval Museum 
Older Romulan ship designs can be reactivated from within the Historical Museum. Build a museum and contact them to adjust your designs.
TECH_UNLOCK_MEGASTRUCTURE_UND_HABITAT_DE:
Undine Bio Habitat 
A large space-bound facility that allows the Undine to grow and expand at a faster rate, which is perfect for their dominance over inferior species.

Additional Defensive Platforms

Defense Grid Upgrade: Additional Defensive Platforms
TECH_UNLOCK_MORE_DANGEROUS_TECHS_DESC:
Higher Chance of Dangerous Techs 
The Think Tank is composed of scientists who come up with new radical ideas to overcome problems. Some of these solutions are less than orthodox.
TECH_UNLOCK_MORE_DANGEROUS_TECHS_TITLE: Unlocks Improvement: Higher Chance of Dangerous Techs
TECH_UNLOCK_MOVING_LINK_DESC:
Moving the Great Link 
The Great Link is a unique and complex biome composed of a countless number of our gods, intertwined. When needed, in times of great effort and secrecy, we can relocate them to create the Link anywhere, on a different planet. Our new home will never be the same.
TECH_UNLOCK_MOVING_LINK_TITLE: Unlocks Megastructure: Moving the Great Link
TECH_UNLOCK_NANITE_NANITE_DISTRICT_DESC:
Analysis 
Analysis districts now produce more £ Nanites.
TECH_UNLOCK_NAVALCAPMILITARY_DISTRICT_DE:
Naval Capacity 
Every military job (Admirals, Commodores and Soldiers) now gains a +1 £ Naval Capacity bonus.
TECH_UNLOCK_NAVALCAP_PER_SOLDIER_DESC:
Increased Naval Capacity 
By setting up their own planetary defenses, military personnel slightly expand the naval capacity of the empire.

Adds +1 Naval Capacity for every Soldier, Enforcer, Commodore and Admiral job.
TECH_UNLOCK_NORCADIAN_ENTERTAINMENT_DESC:
Entertainment 
Our entertainment buildings are more effective now.
TECH_UNLOCK_PARATRINIC_SHIELD_DESC:
Paratrinic Shields II 
Paratrinic shielding is a type of advanced form of deflector shield technology.
TECH_UNLOCK_PHASER_PRINCIPLES_DESC:
Phaser Weaponry 
Phasers fire nadions at their target which interfere with the nuclear forces that bind atoms together. Unusually versatile, nadion beams can be adapted for many uses such as heating, drilling, stunning, killing or disintegrating.
TECH_UNLOCK_PHYSRESEARCH_DISTRICT_DESC:
Research 
Research districts now produce more £ Physics Research.
TECH_UNLOCK_PLANET_ECONOMIC_POLICIES_DES:
Economics 
This allows adjustment of the economic policy across all the worlds, and the balance between civilian and military spending.
TECH_UNLOCK_PLANET_FOOD_POLICIES_DESC:
Food 
This allows adjustment of the food policy across all the worlds.
TECH_UNLOCK_PLANET_SPECIALIZATION_FORGE_:
Forge 
Dedication of an entire world over the industrialisation of the surface, where every raw resource is used to produce or manufacture another product.
TECH_UNLOCK_PLANET_SPECIALIZATION_RELIGI:
Religious 
Ensuring our most sacred worlds are kept as pure as possible is a valuable boon for our species.
TECH_UNLOCK_PLANET_SPECIALIZATION_RESORT:
Resort Planet 
With much landscaping, a luxurious planet can be designated with recreational accomodations, activities and wonderful scenery. Citizens from many empires covet visiting worlds like this.
TECH_UNLOCK_PLANET_SPEC_CLONING_DESC:
Cloning 
An entire world dedicated to the mass production of clones created from specific genetic material.
TECH_UNLOCK_PLANET_SPEC_COMMERCE_DESC:
Commercial World 
The buying and selling of products on a galactic scale requires certain laws, regulations and transactional technology. By creating a world as a freeport for all traders, it can be dedicated to trade, bringing in a large amount of wealth.
TECH_UNLOCK_PLANET_SPEC_EMBASSY_DESC:
Embassy World 
A neutral ground where citizens of numerous races are allowed to speak, trade and communicate freely.
TECH_UNLOCK_PLANET_SPEC_FORTRESS_DESC:
Fortress World 
Bristling with turrets, mines, weapons facilities and forges, the fortress is an almost impenetrable world that stands as a bastion against enemies.
TECH_UNLOCK_PLANET_SPEC_HUNTER_HIROGEN_D:
Hunting World 
Unleashing worthy prey and giving them advantageous terrain to call their own makes the hunt all the more thrilling. By dedicating a world to hunting practices we can ensure our population never strays far.
TECH_UNLOCK_PLANET_SPEC_MUSEUM_DESC:
Planetary Museum 
The Hur'Q curate entire cultures and civilizations for their own purposes. The creation of a world dedicated to this is an important step for their insectoid minds.
TECH_UNLOCK_PLANET_SPEC_PENAL_DESC:
Penal Colony 
Prisoners from across the galaxy can be sentenced to a penal colony, removing the requirements for prisons on our worlds.
TECH_UNLOCK_PLANET_SPEC_RESORT_DESC:
Resort Planet 
With much landscaping, a luxurious planet can be designated with recreational accomodations, activities and wonderful scenery. Citizens from many empires covet visiting worlds like this.
TECH_UNLOCK_PLANET_SPEC_RETREAT_DESC:
Religious Retreat Planet 
Some worlds have a deeper purpose to certain civilisations, and dedicating these worlds as a religious retreat allows it's natural resources to be preserved.
TECH_UNLOCK_PLANET_SPEC_RETREAT_TITLE: Unlocks Planet Specialisation: Religious Retreat Planet
TECH_UNLOCK_PLANET_SPEC_UNIVERSITY_DESC:
University World 
The whole world, entirely dedicated to research and academic pursuits across a wide variety of fields, will become the hub of science and technology.
TECH_UNLOCK_PLANET_TRADE_POLICIES_DESC:
Trade 
This allows adjustment of the trade policy across all the worlds.
TECH_UNLOCK_POPGROWTH_FARM_DISTRICT_DESC:
Agricultural 
Agricultural districts now increase £ Population Growth.
TECH_UNLOCK_PREDESC_WORD_OF_ALAR_DESC:
The Word of Alar 
The Word of Alar improves the opinion of other races significantly.
TECH_UNLOCK_PREDESC_WORD_OF_ALAR_TITLE: Opinion Improved: The Word of Alar
TECH_UNLOCK_PRIVATE_COLONY_SHIP_DESC:
Private Colony Ship 
Colony ships are single-use vessels for settling on alien worlds. Upon colonization, the ship is scuttled and converted into a planetary shelter and foothold.
TECH_UNLOCK_PRIVATE_COLONY_SHIP_TITLE: Unlocks Ship Type: Private Colony Ship
TECH_UNLOCK_PURGING_POLICIES_DESC:
Purging 
Lesser races can be useful to our industrial complex, though how long they are useful for is a matter of policy.
TECH_UNLOCK_RAWDIL_INDUSTRIAL_DISTRICT_D:
Industrial/Production 
Industrial districts now produce more £ Dilithium.
TECH_UNLOCK_REACTOR_1_DESC:
Central Fusion Power Core 
To be able to function in deep space our stations require large power sources. With our understanding of fission we have come up with a reactor that is nuclear in nature which will provide power to our stations.
TECH_UNLOCK_REACTOR_1_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Central Fusion Power Core
TECH_UNLOCK_REACTOR_2_DESC:
Electrostatic Fusion Power Core 
A Electrostatic Fusion Power Core uses an electric field to heat plasma to fusion conditions resulting in the increase in the amount of power we can provide to our stations.
TECH_UNLOCK_REACTOR_2_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Electrostatic Fusion Power Core
TECH_UNLOCK_REACTOR_3_DESC:
Carbon Reaction Fusion Power Core 
An upgrade to our Central Fusion Power Core by allowing the nuclear fusion reaction of three helium 4 nuclei generates carbon and oxygen as byproduct on occasion, thereby, releasing this energy in a high temperature plasma, further increasing the power of our stations.
TECH_UNLOCK_REACTOR_3_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Carbon Reaction Fusion Power Core
TECH_UNLOCK_REACTOR_4_DESC:
Deuterium Fusion Power Core 
The final upgrade of our central fusion reactors uses pure Deuterium fusion which releases more than four times the energy compared to early stage He3 reactors. By integrating a phase discriminator in the confinement tokamak allows us to pierce the coulomb barrier and to develop a safer, more efficient and powerful fusion reactor for our stations.
TECH_UNLOCK_REACTOR_4_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Deuterium Fusion Power Core
TECH_UNLOCK_REACTOR_5_DESC:
Fusion Array Power Core 
A new type of fusion reactor that cascades the phase discriminator field around an array of reactors, thereby decreasing the energy requirements to maintain fusion, thus increasing even more the efficiency and energy output for our station reactors.
TECH_UNLOCK_REACTOR_5_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Fusion Array Power Core
TECH_UNLOCK_REACTOR_6_DESC:
Tetryonic Power Core 
This station reactor uses Tetryon, which is a type of subatomic particle that originates from subspace. By extruding the particle field through different subspace manifolds in a controlled manner, it's possible to extract energy from the shallower subspace strata without the dangers of tetryonic radiation thereby creating a new type of reactor for our stations that has unprecedented power efficiency.
TECH_UNLOCK_REACTOR_7_DESC:
Chroniton Power Core 
Harnessing the power of subatomic particles with temporal properties known as Chronitons has enabled our reactors to draw energy from space-time itself. This new type of power core nears the pinnacle of energy generation itself.
TECH_UNLOCK_REACTOR_8_DESC:
Decalithium Fusion Power Core 
Using the rare refined Decalithium, this reactor can supply massive amounts of supplementary power when a vessel requires it.
TECH_UNLOCK_REACTOR_8_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Decalithium Fusion Power Core
TECH_UNLOCK_REACTOR_9_DESC:
Temporal Power Core 
A temporal core, which kept the vessel out of phase with normal spacetime, thereby protecting it from the changes to the timeline which it initiated.
TECH_UNLOCK_REACTOR_XINDI_KEMOCITE_DESC:
Xindi Kemocite Reactor 
The Arboreals produce the finest variaty of Kemocite in the Delphic Expanse and this Kemocite fuels the Weapon and the craft that houses it.
TECH_UNLOCK_REQUIRED_DEFENSE_ARMOR_1_DES:
Deflector Fields 
Deflector fields projected around our vessel protect it from small objects whilst travelling at high velocities.
TECH_UNLOCK_RESEARCH_DISTRICTS_BASIC_DES:
Administrative 
The Administrative district is now available.

These sections are available only to the £ Battleship class group.
TECH_UNLOCK_SECTION_CRUISER_ADVANCED_DES:

Diseños avanzados de Starship 
Los centros de investigación y desarrollo pueden ahora planificar para buques altamente especializados que sean más adecuados para la tarea a mano, con opciones adicionales en armamento y servicios públicos.

Beam Mounts 
This tech dictates us a general design philosophy concerning energy weapons, and whether we prefer beam or cannon mounts. This applies to every military ship in our arsenal.

TECH_UNLOCK_SECTION_MISSILE_DESC:
Missile Boat 
A specialised design for light starships using early plasma torpedo weaponry, this design emphasizes the use of numerous light torpedo emplacements.

This design can be used on £ Patrol Frigates and £ Destroyers.
TECH_UNLOCK_SECTION_SUPERIOR_CIVILIAN_DE:
Advanced Civilian Sections

These sections are available to every civilian ship class.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIELD_1_DESC:
Shields 
The deflector shield is a force field, or generally an energy field, which serves primarily to protect a spacecraft from radiation, attacks or solid bodies.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIELD_2A_DESC:
Escudos Covariantes 
El blindaje de deflector Covariant utilisa múltiples campos de fuerza de entrelazado para crear una solución realmente resistente que sea más duradera que sus contrapartes.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIELD_2B_DESC: Los escudos regenerativos consisten en una red distribuida de emisores de pantalla, permitiendo una infusión rápida de nueva energía a la matriz de blindaje.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIELD_3A_DESC:
Covariant Shields III 
Covariant deflector shielding uses multiple interlacing force fields to create a truly resilient solution that are more durable than their counterparts.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIELD_3B_DESC:
Regenerative Shields III

Paratrinic Shields I 
Paratrinic shielding is a type of advanced form of deflector shield technology.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIPYARD_TEMPORAL_DESC:
Temporal Shipyards Facility 
A specially designed facility to host the construction of a great temporal time ship.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_ASSAULT_CRUISER_DESC:
Crucero de asalto 
Uno de los diseños más avanzados de la nave estelar, los cruceros de asalto están equipados con poderosas armas delanteras, capaces de borrar a los oponentes desde lejos
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_ASSAULT_CRUISER_TITLE: Desbloquea tipo de nave: Crucero de asalto
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_BATTLECRUISER_DESC:
Crucero de Batalla 
Battlecruisers campo de las baterías de torpedo más grandes de cualquier diseño de buque conocido. Sus salvas fuertes son capaces de borrar los vasos más pequeños en un instante
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_BATTLECRUISER_TITLE: Desbloquea tipo de nave: Crucero de Batalla
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_BATTLESHIP_DESC:
Acorazado 
El acorazado es uno de los barcos más grandes para servir en la marina de cualquier imperio. Es enérgico defensivo y capacidades de apoyo que los hacen temibles oponentes en combate
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_BATTLESHIP_PRAETOR_DESC:
Praetor Battleship 
Romulan Battleship designed to demonstrate the power of the Praetor inside and outside of the Star Empire.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_BORG_CUBE_DESC:
Cube 
The Cube is a robust and heavily armed vessel, making it ideal for patrolling our space or leading an assimilation mission. Few species possess the technology or volume of ships required to resist a cube.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_BORG_DIAMOND_DESC:
Diamond 
The Diamond is more heavily armed and durable than the Sphere. Too expensive to be expendable, too vulnerable for front line aggression, this vessel is often used for secondary combat roles, assimilation support, and special tasks.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_BORG_PROBE_DESC:
Probe 
The Probe is an expendable scout starship. The craft has an elongated shape suitable for mounting light weapons and scanners, suitable for initial forays into potentially hostile space.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_BORG_PYRAMID_DESC:
Pyramid 
The Pyramid is an incremental improvement over early Borg ship designs. It has a sturdy pyramidal shape suitable for mounting heavier weaponry and equipment on its larger surface area.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_BORG_SCOUT_DESC:
Cone 
The simplistic design and rotational symmetry of the Borg cone allows for a more advanced scouting vessel, capable of equipping numerous weapons around its conical shape. With more drones onboard, it is more suitable to assimilating new cultures as well.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_BORG_SPHERE_DESC:
Sphere 
The Sphere is a long-range tactical vessel, significantly better armed than the Probe. This makes it suitable for the role of scouting potentially hostile space and assisting in the assimilation of new species.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_CITY_SHIP_DESC:
City Ship 
A massive Voth vessel capable of housing entire populations of the Voth species. Outfitted with particularly large weaponry, shielding, and engines, it can act by itself or as flagship of a fleet.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_CIV_ELEOS_DESC:
Phoenix Class 
The Phoenix class was designed as a small rapid-response vessel, delivering medical supplies, engineering components, or limited personal transfer. The class focused on speed at a small scale and was recommended for mid range missions within the Alpha Quadrant.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_CRUISER_DESC:
Crucero 
Un avance significativo en el diseño de la nave estelar, el tamaño impresionante del crucero se corresponde con su serie de armas de mayor escala y sistemas defensivos adicionales
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_DESTROYER_DESC:
Destructor 
Significativamente más grande que la fragata de patrulla, el destructor es un barco de línea de frente muy barato y eficaz que es capaz de ser producido rápidamente mientras que coloca toneladas de capacidades ofensivas para su precio
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_32_DESC:
32nd Century Designs 
Schematics provided to us by the future Starfleet, which will allow us to refit our existing ships to the designs used in the 32nd Century.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_ACHILLES_DESC:
Achilles Class 
Designed to be the achilles heel of enemy fleets, and the answer to large warships fielded by rival powers.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_ADVANCED_EXCELSIOR_:
Excelsior Class 
The Excelsior-class features the saucer section - engineering section - warp nacelle layout common to most Starfleet vessels. However, it features a more streamlined design than seen in previous classes.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_ADVANCED_VESTA_DESC:
Vesta Class 
The Vesta-class starship is designed to serve as a testbed for a number of new Starfleet technologies. Its unique, sleek hull design is designed to allow the potential for the vessel to break into the quantum slipstream.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_ADV_CRUISER_INQUIRY:
Inquiry Class 
The Inquiry class was the newest type of starship operated by Starfleet and was considered by some as the toughest, fastest, most powerful ship Starfleet ever put into service.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_AKYAZI_DESC:
Akyazi Class 
Designed to act as Border Patrol ships to respond quickly to situations that may arise and need an urgent response.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_ARCHETYPE_ADVANCED_:
Advanced Cruiser 
Advanced cruisers are the only ships capable of equipping advanced types of warp engines. They can also equip sniper sensors and extra-large energy weapons.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_ARCHETYPE_ESCORT_DE:
Heavy Escort 
Heavy Escorts are pure damage dealers, gaining extra tactical utilities slots.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_ARCHETYPE_EXPLORATI:
Exploration Cruiser 
Exploration cruisers are the largest and heaviest ships you can build, coming with support auras, as well as fighter bays, and extra aux utilities slots.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_ARCHETYPE_EXPLORER_:
Long-Range Explorer 
Explorers are light-medium cruisers that have improved thrusters and computers, tractor beams, and extra science utility slots.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_ARCHETYPE_FRIGATE_D:
Frigate 
The Emmette-type is an early type of starship operated on Earth before the NX-class of starships. It is very lightly armed.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_ARCHETYPE_HEAVY_DES:
Heavy Cruiser 
Heavy cruisers are powerful vessels, capable of equipping skirmisher sensors, and have extra engineering utilities slots.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_ARCHETYPE_LIGHT_DES:
Light Cruiser 
Light Cruisers are interceptors, capable of equipping picket sensors and point-defense weapons. They can also equip exotic torpedo types.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_ARCHETYPE_MMV_DESC:
Multi-Mission Vessel 
Multi-Mission Vessels are medium cruisers capable of equipping most weapon types, including fighters and extra-large energy weapons. They have debuff auras capable of hampering your enemy as well.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_ARGONAUT_DESC:
Argonaut Class 
The Argonaut-class starship is a combination cruiser developed as a more combat-oriented version of the Intrepid-class. Though initially intended to serve during the Dominion War, these vessels didn't enter service until the early 2380s due to design challenges.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_CENTURY_DESC:
Century Class 
The Century-class owed several of its design elements to the more military focused Sovereign-class. Starfleet grew concerned about a perceived deficit in its range of modern deep space explorers and, following early successes, is gradually being constructed in greater numbers.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_CENT_REFIT_DESC:
Resolute Class Refit 
Breakthrough technologies have given the Excelsior Class a new lease of life, Starfleet engineers have managed to retrofit them onto the Centaur-Class, which can be brought out of retirement to serve the fleet.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_COMMAND_CRUISER_ODY:
Odyssey Class 
The Odyssey-class was a type of Federation starship that was the pinnacle of Federation starship design and would carry the Federation into a new generation of exploration.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_DAUNTLESS_DESC:
Dauntless Class 
The Dauntless was constructed as a prototype for the new Slipstream Technology, after initial tests failed the design was passed to project Pathfinder.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_DEIMOS_DESC:
Deimos Class 
A top-secret vessel with state of the art technology ready for Section 31 to use to protect the Federation.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_ESCORT_PROMETHEUS_D:
Prometheus Class 
Following on from the success of the Defiant programme, the Prometheus's main feature is the multi-vector assault mode, which allowes a Prometheus-class escort to split into three warp-capable, combat-ready sections: Alpha, Beta and Gamma.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_EXCALIBUR_DESC:
Excalibur Class 
Starfleet approved a number of designs to act as deep space command vessels marshalling fleets on the very edge of its known space.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_EXPLORATION_FEDERAT:
Federation Class 
The Federation-Class vessels were designed to support Starfleet's efforts to maintain stability and provide an exploration hub at the far reaches of its borders.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_EXPLORATION_GALAXY_:
Galaxy Class 
The Galaxy has the dubious distinction of having the longest design, development, and construction period of any class in Starfleet history. The Galaxy-class does not present any particular technological revolution, but is the culmination of several Starfleet technologies to date. One of the largest classes of ships constructed by Starfleet, it accommodates not just the crew but also their families and other civilians in spacious quarters, providing extensive recreational areas, including the latest in holodeck technology. Intended primarily as a ship of exploration, its size and facilities allow unsupported missions of up to a decade, if necessary.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_EXPLORATION_LUNA_DE:
Luna Class 
Luna-class ships were the top of the line in Starfleet's scientific and exploratory pursuits on behalf of the United Federation of Planets.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_EXPLORER_CARDENAS_D:
Cardenas Class 
One of the few Federation designs that sports more than two nacelles, the Cardenas-class sports four.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_EXPLORER_HOOVER_DES:
Hoover Class 
A saucer atop two nacelles, the Hoover is the next step in compact design.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_EXPLORER_INTREPID_D:
Intrepid 
The Intrepid class is Starfleet's answer to their growing need for a versatile and quick class of starships capable of excellent maneuvering at both impulse and warp speed. With their variable geometry warp nacelles, the Intrepids have greater control of their warp field, with the added bonus of not damaging the subspace layer.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_EXPLORER_LUNA_DESC:
Luna Class 
Luna-class ships were the top of the line in Starfleet's scientific and exploratory pursuits on behalf of the United Federation of Planets.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_EXPLORER_MIRANDA_DE:
Miranda Class 
Designed to be modular to fit different requirements, the Miranda-class is composed of a single primary hull. Mounted on the underside of the primary hull are two nacelle pylons connected to the warp nacelles. Design features of the primary hull include a docking port located on the forward section of the ship; the aft section includes two shuttlebays, separated by the vessel's impulse engines.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_EXPLORER_NEW_ORLEAN:
New Orleans Class 
Sharing similar, but smaller, designs as the Galaxy-class, the New Orleans is also outfitted with two 'Sharpie' class sensor pods atop the saucer.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_EXPLORER_NX_DESC:
NX Class 
Conceived in the early 22nd century as part of the NX Project at the Warp Five Complex, the NX-class is the first true exploration vessel.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_FARRAGUT_DESC:
Farragut Class 
The Farragut type consisted of a saucer section without a separate engineering section. The main deflector and nacelle pylons were mounted directly on the ventral surface of the saucer.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_FRIGATE_AKULA_DESC:
Akula Class 
Recognizing the need for an improvement to the Saladin, the Akula has two nacelles: one ventral and one dorsal to the saucer.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_FRIGATE_CALIFORNIA_:
California Class 
Once envisioned as pioneer vessels of the fleet, further advances have rendered the Californa Class the workhorse ships of the fleet.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_FRIGATE_CHALLENGER_:
Challenger Class 
While utilising the wide saucer of this era with large phaser arrays, the Challenger still maintains the dorsal and ventral nacelles of previous eras.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_FRIGATE_ENGLE_DESC:
Engle Class 
Named after Joe Engle, a test pilot from 20th Century Earth, the Engle-class has its nacelles astride the saucer.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_FRIGATE_MAGEE_DESC:
Magee Class 
A saucer with two armoured nacelles built directly into it, protruding fore and aft, provide a unique-looking light cruiser.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_FRIGATE_SALADIN_DES:
Saladin Class 
The Saladin-class consists of a saucer section and only a single nacelle. Whilst inexpensive to construct, it lacks the power of twin-nacelled vessels.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_HEAVY_ARES_DESC:
Ares Class 
Launched in a time of war, the Ares class ship is the first pure warship designed and built by the Federation. A counter to the growth of nearby Empires, the Ares-class ship is officially labeled as a 'Heavy Destroyer' due to its size, and because the larger Constitution-class ship currently being built are already categorized as Heavy Cruisers.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_HEAVY_CONSTITUTION_:
Constitution Class Mark II 
The largest and most elaborate class Starfleet had yet fielded, with an unprecedented fourteen research labs each, ships of the Constitution-class are the most extensive mobile research platforms ever deployed by the Federation and are responsible for expanding known space by thousands of cubic parsecs.

Constitution Class Mark I 
The largest and most elaborate class Starfleet had yet fielded, with an unprecedented fourteen research labs each, ships of the Constitution-class are the most extensive mobile research platforms ever deployed by the Federation and are responsible for expanding known space by thousands of cubic parsecs.
Unlocks Ship: Constitution Class Mark I
Unlocks Ship: Constitution Class Mark II
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_HEAVY_CRUISER_YORKT:
Yorktown Class 
Starfleet's first true ship prepared to defend their borders.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_HEAVY_SOVEREIGN_DES:
Sovereign Class 
Intended to be the latest and greatest in Starfleet exploration starships, the Sovereign is also outfitted with defense in mind, due to the growing threat of other nearby empires. Sovereign-class starships are quite adaptable to different missions, whether they be scientific, defensive, or diplomatic.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_HEAVY_SPRINGFIELD_D:
Springfield Class 
The Springfield class was launched in the 24th century, and part of the design lineage that included the larger Galaxy-class. Physically, a ship of the class was comprised of a saucer section, with a v-shaped structure at the back of the hull. This cut provided room for mission-specific modules that could house additional sensors, cargo or weapons. A pair of downward-turned pylons suspended the secondary hull beneath the saucer.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_INTERCEPTOR_DESC:
Interceptor-Class Refit 
The Interceptor-class starship is an accumulation of five years of research and development. The task Starfleet Command gave its engineers was to create a relatively small, multi-platform starship that utilized the current state-of-the-art technologies, and was short on construction time and costs utilising the Intrepid Class spaceframe.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_IWO_JIMA_DESC:
Iwo Jima Class 
The ship class is named in honor of Iwo Jima, which was the scene of bloody fighting in the Pacific theater during World War II on Earth and like the battle this ship class is tough allowing the safe delivery of federation troops.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_LIGHT_BONAVENTURE_D:
Bonaventure Class 
A central deflector dish in the saucer section and twin nacelles provide a unique-looking light cruiser.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_LIGHT_CENTAUR_DESC:
Centaur Class 
A compact design featuring only a saucer section connected directly to a small secondary weapons pod, which houses four photon torpedo tubes. The ship's nacelles are connected directly to the pod.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_LIGHT_CURRY_DESC:
Curry Class 
A unique cruiser design where the saucer is set atop the middle of the main hull, and the two nacelles are connected to the saucer.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_LIGHT_KELVIN_DESC:
Kelvin Class 
Technology gained from the anomaly has resulted in this larger, more powerful light cruiser.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_LIGHT_NIAGARA_DESC:
Niagara Class 
A fast cruiser in the service of Starfleet, this design is rare for its triple-nacelle configuration.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_LIGHT_PARLIAMENT_DE:
Parliament Class 
The Parliament-class starships was designed to engage in large complex engineering projects using advanced techology.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_LIGHT_SABER_DESC:
Saber Class 
One of the smaller starship designs in service, the Saber has a crew complement of approximately 40 people.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_LIGHT_SHEPARD_DESC:
Shepard Class 
As Starfleet continued to experiment with the streamlined hull and elongated nacelles the Shepard Class was created.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_LIGHT_STEAMRUNNER_D:
Steamrunner Class 
The need for a sturdy design resulted in the Steamrunner, which affixes the nacelles through the saucer and onto the main hull at numerous points.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_LOKNAR_DESC:
Loknar Class 
The Loknar Class was designed by a team of Andorians looking to transfer some of the principles of the Andorian Imperial Guard into the fledgling Starfleet.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_MMV_AKIRA_DESC:
Akira Class 
The Akira-class is heavily armed with an amazing twenty torpedo launchers, capable of firing either photon or quantum torpedoes, as well as tricobalt devices.

However, one of the ship's defining features is its large main shuttlebay. One of the largest such facilities on any Federation vessel, the Akira's shuttlebay encompasses almost a third of the ship's saucer section, allowing the Akira-class to act as a fighter carrier, as well as a cruiser. Its complement of forty fighters exit through the forward shuttlebay doors and return through one of two aft bays.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_MMV_CONSTELLATION_D:
Constellation Class 
The Constellation-class is designed for operating independently of Starfleet Command in the remote reaches of the Federation, and has a rare dual twin-nacelle configuration with pylons on both dorsal and ventral sides of the ship.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_MMV_NEBULA_DESC:
Nebula Class 
The Nebula-class is well-known for being a testbed of modular components, with the vessel's upper outboard structures varying from vessel to vessel. Several configurations include a tactical pod, sensor pod, cargo pod, and probe pod, making it useful for a varied-mission role.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_MMV_NORWAY_DESC:
Norway Class 
The Norway class has a very low profile, similar to the Steamrunner and Akira classes, designed to make it a harder target in combat. Norway-class vessels are almost flat, featuring a triangular primary hull with two rectangular beams projecting rearward from the top of saucer, to which compact nacelle pylons support the warp nacelles.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_MMV_POSEIDON_DESC:
Poseidon 
The Poseidon class is the first true multi-mission vessel designed for deep space exploration.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_MMV_RADIANT_DESC:
Radiant Class 
The Radiant Class is the next generation in four nacelled vessels focusing on exploration.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_MMV_SAGAN_DESC:
Sagan Class 
Bringing together the memories of past designs with the revolutionary technology of the present, the Sagan is the next level of exploration.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_MMV_WALKER_DESC:
Walker Class 
The design of the Walker-class consists of a saucer section with an integrated, laterally-positioned navigational deflector, a compact secondary hull, and two nacelles attached by pylons that extend beneath the ship's superstructure.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_NXBETA_DESC:
NX Beta Fighter 
The NX-Beta was Earth's second NX prototype test ship, active in the 2140s. Its exterior design shared many similarities with Earth's first warp prototype, the Phoenix.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_NXDISCOVERY_DESC:
NX Discovery Class 
As the United Earth fleets explored further into space meeting new races a greater call came to defend its own borders. Modifying existing vessels with newer technology breeds new life into these ships.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_PATHFINDER_DESC:
Pathfinder Class 
An advanced version of the Intrepid-Class the pathfinder is designed to travel far from Federation space to explore and investigate.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_PEGASUS_DESC:
Pegasus Refit 
Named for the fabled winged horse that epitomizes the desire to look at new technologies and test new designs.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_POLARIS_DESC:
Polaris Class 
The more combat oriented of Starfleet's most advance line of Starships. The Polaris fills the role of the Heavy Cruiser complimenting the Sovereign and Century.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_PROTOTYPE_ADVANCED_:
Advanced Cruiser 
The Crossfield-class is a type of experimental Federation starship. Its design consists of a saucer section, a wide secondary hull, and two elongated nacelles. Due to the vessel's specialised technology, the saucer is split into three sections, allowing for free rotation.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_PROTOTYPE_ESCORT_DE:
Heavy Escort 
The Defiant-class is one of many new Starfleet classes developed in response to the threat of other races. The class is the first that Starfleet developed purely as a warship in this era, and it is often called over-powered and over-gunned for its size.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_PROTOTYPE_EXPLORATI:
Exploration Cruiser 
The Ambassador-class is designed to be a replacement for the aging fleet of Excelsior-class and Constellation-class vessels.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_PROTOTYPE_EXPLORER_:
Explorer 
The NX-class was commissioned as an exploratory vessel as a medium for the new warp-5 engine and was originally fitted with a polarized hull and phase cannons.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_PROTOTYPE_HEAVY_DES:
Heavy Cruiser 
The Nimitz-class Cruiser utilises twin-nacelles atop an armoured and reinforced saucer section.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_PROTOTYPE_LIGHT_DES:
Light Cruiser 
A half saucer with twin nacelles atop the hull create the first Earth light cruiser.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_PROTOTYPE_MMV_DESC:
Multi-Mission Vessel 
The Walker-class fits the bill for a multi-mission vessel for the Federation.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_PROXIMA_DESC:
Proxima Class 
The Proxima-class was a type of Federation starship first built by Starfleet in the mid-23rd century. It was considered to be a battleship and was extremely heavily armed.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_RAVEN_DESC:
Aerie Class Refit 
The Aerie vessels were used for a variety of purposes, including service as surveyors and colony ships in both Starfleet and civilian service.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_REFIT_AKIRA_DESC:
Thunderchild Refit 
The upgraded version of the Akira, the Thunderchild is constructed using the latest materials and technologies. It is the pinnacle of this class.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_REFIT_CONSTITUTION_:
Constitution Class Second Stage Overhaul 
The removal of the nacelle fins and overall systems overhaul created the Second Stage of the Constitution-class.
Unlocks Refit: Constitution Class Second Stage Overhaul

Constitution Class Advanced Flagship 
The new upgrade proposals all share a more efficient power plant, with some versions streamlining the hull for better warpfield geometry, and others emphasizing enhanced weaponry or science capability; the final design merges many of the proposals into a vessel worth of holding the title of Flagship.
Unlocks Refit: Constitution Class Advanced Flagship
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_REFIT_EDISON_DESC:
Edison Class Refit 
The breakthroughs made during the construction of the Constitution Class have been retrofitted onto the aging Hoover frame to breathe new life into the class.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_REFIT_EMETTE_DESC:
Neptune Refit 
Improvements to the Emmette-type resulted in the warp 2 capable Neptune-class, which includes the future basis for bridge and engine room designs.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_REFIT_ENDEAVOUR_DES:
NX Endeavour Refit 
Utilising the full capacity of the NX frame, the Endeavour Class is the ultimate and final evolution of the NX class.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_REFIT_EXCELSIOR_DES:
Lakota Refit 
The design of the Excelsior has undergone a major refit, which includes a new bridge module, in addition to a significant modification to the aft portion of the saucer section surrounding the impulse drive, and a modification to the cargo bay on the aft ventral portion of the ship.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_REFIT_GALAXY_1_DESC:
Venture Refit 
Shortcomings in the prestigious Galaxy-class result in the creation of a refit design, primarily to improve the combat capabilities in an ever-dangerous galaxy. Additional phaser arrays along the nacelles are one such provision.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_REFIT_GALAXY_2_DESC:
Galaxy X Refit 
In response to increased hostility with nearby empires, the newly redesigned Galaxy has improved weaponry, shielding, and sensors. It also includes the addition of a third nacelle.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_REFIT_INQUIRY_DESC:
Curiosity Class Refit 
The Curiosity Class takes the progress made with the Inquiry Class but conforms to Starfleets more explorational roots.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_REFIT_LEXINGTON_DES:
Lexington Refit 
The final refit of the aging Excelsior space frame includes a number of technologies tested on classes such as the Ambassador and extends the life of this ship by bringing its frame in line with other ships of the era.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_REFIT_MIRANDA_1_DES:
Miranda Second Generation Refit 
The success of the Miranda class resulted in a complete overhaul of the design with modern materials and construction techniques.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_REFIT_MIRANDA_1_TIT: Unlocks Refit: Miranda Second Generation Refit
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_REFIT_MIRANDA_2_DES:
Miranda Third Generation Refit 
The continued success of the Miranda class programme once again resulted in a final overhaul of the design with modern materials and construction techniques, as well as improved weapons and hull plating.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_REFIT_MIRANDA_2_TIT: Unlocks Refit: Miranda Third Generation Refit
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_REFIT_MMV_AKIRA_DES:
Thunderchild Refit 
The upgraded version of the Akira, the Thunderchild is constructed using the latest materials and technologies. It is the pinnacle of this class.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_REFIT_NX_2_DESC:
Endeavour Refit 
Starfleet's corp of Engineers have managed to eek out every last advance from the reliable NX space frame. The Endeavour maximises the warp 5 engine to its full potential.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_REFIT_NX_DESC:
Columbia Refit 
The Columbia-class is born out of the existing, and proven, NX-class design, and includes retrofitted ships such as Enterprise and USS Endeavour. It is named, at the insistence of Admiral Jonathan Archer, after the first vessel of the NX-class to be lost in action, Columbia.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_REFIT_OBENA_DESC:
Obena Refit 
The most complete refit of the classic Excelsior design replacing the hull, weapons and warp drive. A classic design for the 24th century.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_REFIT_PROXIMA_DESC:
Proxima Refit 
Refitting the all-ready powerful Proxima Class with the latest technological breakthroughs creates a force to be reckoned with.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_REFIT_RANGER_DESC:
Ranger Class Refit 
The Walker Class proved to be an extremely resilient ship class and an ideal choice to redesign and test new technology.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_REFIT_SHRAN_DESC:
Shran Class Refit 
Following the successful upgrade and refit of the Constitution Class. The Shran Class makes use of these design upgrades to extend the life of this vessel.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_REFIT_SPOKANE_DESC:
Spokane Refit 
The Curry Class was pulled together from a variety of ships, but suffered from integration issues. The Spokane refines the cohension of these components to produce a more efficent final version.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_REFIT_VIGILANT_DESC:
Vigilant Refit 
A refined version of the classic Defiant space frame, capable of fast response and high impact.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_SHANGRI_LA_DESC:
Shangri-La Class 
Designed to complement and work alongside the Constitution as a fast response vessel that still packs a punch.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_TERRAN_DREADNOUGHT_:
Vengeance Class 
Terran scientists tasked with the order to reverse engineer the mighty Dreadnought have produced this fearsome design.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_TEXAS_DESC:
Texas Class 
The Texas class was a type of Federation starship operated by Starfleet in the late 24th century. It was the organization's first fully automated starship.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FED_TYPHON_DESC:
Typhon Class 
A mixture between a 'mobile outpost and carrier starship'. It possessed both scientific and medical facilities allowing it to perform its mission role. Ships of this class were armed with both pulse phaser turrets and quantum torpedoes.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FLAGSHIP_DESC:
Flagship 
An advanced massive dreadnaught that is equipped with heavy weaponry, fighter bays, and armour. It can act by itself or as flagship of a fleet.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_FRIGATE_CHALLENGER_DESC:
Challenger Class 
While utilising the wide saucer of this era with large phaser arrays, the Challenger still maintains the dorsal and ventral nacelles of previous eras.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_HEAVY_ESCORT_DESC:
Escolta pesada 
La escolta pesada lleva una impresionante capacidad ofensiva a pesar de su pequeño tamaño y alta maniobrabilidad
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_HEAVY_ESCORT_TITLE: Desbloquea tipo de nave: Escolta pesada
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_ROM_ARCHETYPE_BATTLESHI:
Battleship 
The need for larger vessels to compete with neighbouring empires has resulted in the creation of large battleships designed purely for war.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_ROM_ARCHETYPE_BOP_DESC:
Bird-of-Prey 
Gaining its name from the bold pattern of an alien bird's feathers painted on the ship's ventral hull, these small vessels can be used solo or in swarm techniques against larger vessels.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_ROM_ARCHETYPE_INTERCEPT:
Interceptor 
An interceptor is a type of armed starship designed to intercept incoming or hostile craft. To this end, interceptors typically have powerful warp or impulse engines.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_ROM_ARCHETYPE_STARBIRD_:
Starbird 
Similar to the warbird type, the Starbird is designed for long range detachments.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_ROM_ARCHETYPE_SWORD_DES:
Sword 
The Romulan Star Empire cannot fall behind our neighbours. The Sword class shall be the pinnacle of our ship design, a massive warship capable of destroying lesser fleets single-handedly.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_ROM_ARCHETYPE_WARBIRD_D:
Warbird 
A warbird is a type of heavily armed warship, generally depicted as some sort of alien predatory bird.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_ROM_BATTLESHIP_DDERIDEX:
D'deridex Battleship 
Utilising a forced quantum singularity and the most advanced cloaking device, the D'deridex is designed to be one of the most advanced vessels within the Alpha Quadrant.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_ROM_BATTLESHIP_PRAETOR_:
Praetor Class Battleship 
Romulan Battleship designed to demonstrate the power of the Praetor inside and outside of the Star Empire.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_ROM_BOP_ARHAEL_DESC:
Ar'hael Bird-of-Prey 
Improvements to weapon and torpedo systems have resulted in a new type of Bird-of-Prey.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_ROM_BOP_JOREK_DESC:
Jo'rek Bird-of-Prey 
Improvements to weapon and torpedo systems have resulted in a new type of Bird-of-Prey.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_ROM_BOP_STANET_DESC:
S'tanet Bird-of-Prey 
Improvements to weapon and torpedo systems have resulted in a new type of Bird-of-Prey.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_ROM_INTERCEPTOR_TDAIR_D:
T'Dair Interceptor 
Improvements to impulse and thruster control has resulted in a new class of interceptor.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_ROM_INTERCEPTOR_TLISS_D:
T'Liss Interceptor 
Improvements to impulse and thruster control has resulted in a new class of interceptor.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_ROM_INTERCEPTOR_TMARA_D:
T'Mara Interceptor 
Improvements to impulse and thruster control has resulted in a new class of interceptor.
TECH_UNLOCK_SHIP_ROM_PROTOTYPE_BATTLESHI:
Battleship 
Named after our glorious leaders, these potential battleships should be the flagships of our fleet.

TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_2A_DESC:
Sub-Impulse Thruster 
A new type of thruster that builds upon the operating principles of fusion thrusters. Combines plasma from a fusion reactor with high energy plasma from the warp core.
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_2B_DESC:
Stealth Thruster 
A thruster system designed with stealth as the primary concern. To this end, the high temperature plasma generated by the fusion reactor is cooled, before being highly pressurised and then expelled.
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_3A_DESC:
Impulse Thruster 
Impulse thrusters boosted by creating an anti-gravity wake behind the vessel to push it forward. Limitations in gravity manipulation technology mean that the wake is prone to turbulence issues.
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_3B_DESC:
Paralithium Mk. III Stealth Thruster 
A cold thruster which combines older impulse technology with even older ion engine theories. It is fueled by paralithium, an isotope of lithium which is now widely available thanks to advanced, new synthesis techniques.
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_3B_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Paralithium Mk. III Stealth Thruster
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_4A_DESC:
Avidyne Thruster 
New type of impulse thruster, which eschews the unreliable anti-gravity wake. Instead, engine efficiency is increased by pulsing the plasma exhaust, creating controlled energetic turbulence patterns.
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_4B_DESC:
RCS Mk. IV Stealth Thruster 
Cold thrust impulse engine complimented by a reaction control system fueled by lower temperature plasma than previous models.
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_4B_TITLE: Unlocks Component: RCS Mk. IV Stealth Thruster
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_5A_DESC:
Impulse Manifold 
Impulse engine comprised of a fifth generation or higher Avidyne thruster, fitted with a specialised impulse exhaust manifold.
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_5B_DESC:
Cooled Mk. V Stealth Thruster 
Stealth impulse thruster augmented with cooled impulse capacitor banks. The capacitor banks store cold drive plasma, primarily for use in combat situations.
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_5B_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Cooled Mk. V Stealth Thruster
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_6A_DESC:
Impulse Manifold Mk. VI 
An important milestone in impulse engine technology, this engine is powered solely by high-energy plasma from the warp core; no fusion-produced plasma is required.
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_6A_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Impulse Manifold Mk. VI
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_6B_DESC:
Masked Mk. VI Stealth Thruster 
Stealth thruster system with major improvements. The exhaust manifold has been replaced by an electro-thermal signature masking, multi-vector thruster array.
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_6B_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Masked Mk. VI Stealth Thruster
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_7A_DESC:
Compound Impulse Manifold Mk. VII 
Building on the success of the Shange shunts and the new compound impulse assembly, impulse engine engineers have created a radical new exhaust manifold, featuring an array of high pressure, multi-vector, exhaust ports.
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_7A_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Compound Impulse Manifold Mk. VII
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_7B_DESC:
Paragravitic Drive 
Highly advanced graviton flow dynamics simulation processors have been combined with modern graviton emitters. The result is an impulse engine add-on which uses an 'anti-gravity wake' to push the ship.
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_8A_DESC:
Hyper-Impulse Engine 
A revolution in impulse engine design, the hyper-impulse drive engine uses warp-grade plasma fed from dedicated miniature matter-antimatter reactors.
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_8B_DESC:
Subspace-Shifted Mk. VIII Stealth Thruster 
An incredibly sophisticated stealth engine that uses modified graviton emitters. The gravimetric disturbances that form the 'anti-gravity wake' have been made to catch the expelled plasma as it leaves the impulse manifold and shift it into subspace.
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_8B_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Subspace-Shifted Mk. VIII Stealth Thruster

TECH_UNLOCK_TRANSWARP_ENGINE_1_DESC:
Transwarp Conduit 
Graviton coils create micro singularities to weaken the normal-space/subspace barrier in front of the vessel. Repositioned warp coils create a dense subspace bubble than normal, forcing the vessel through the weakened region of space, into transwarp space.
TECH_UNLOCK_TRANSWARP_ENGINE_2_DESC:
Transwarp Conduit II 
This transwarp coil functions as a gravimetric lens, generating and converting a large force into a subspace distortion. The distortion will allow direct access to transwarp space, maintaining the distortion will allow travel through it.
TECH_UNLOCK_TRANSWARP_ENGINE_3_DESC:
Transwarp Conduit III 
This transwarp coil has been augmented with the ability to generate triaxilating tetryons. The triaxilating tetryons amplify energetic oscillations in the subspace interfold layers, causing distortions to form.
TECH_UNLOCK_TRANSWARP_ENGINE_4_DESC:
Transwarp Conduit IV 
This transwarp coil has been adjusted to allow easier access to our artificial transwarp conduits. Generated and maintained by transwarp node facilities, these artificial conduits are better optimised for the needs of our vessels than naturally occurring conduits.
TECH_UNLOCK_TRANSWARP_ENGINE_5_DESC:
Transwarp Conduit V 
The artificial transwarp conduits have been remodulated to reduce the gravimetric distortion gradient over their cross section. As this generates less resistive force, a higher velocity is attainable.
TECH_UNLOCK_TRANSWARP_ENGINE_6_DESC:
Transwarp Conduit VI 
New transwarp coils are specialised to provide maximum speed and efficiency within natural transwarp conduits, at the expense of being able to enter the remaining few natural, unassimilated conduits.
TECH_UNLOCK_TRANSWARP_ENGINE_7_DESC:
Transwarp Conduit VII 
This transwarp coil is able to automatically link to the interspatial manifolds ahead of the vessel, giving them details about the ship and alter the conduit to optimise it for the vessel's parameters.
TECH_UNLOCK_TRANSWARP_ENGINE_8_DESC:
Transwarp Conduit VIII 
The interspatial manifold network is now responsible for maintaining the transwarp conduits and autonomously growing the network. This transwarp coil is able to automatically link to the interspatial manifolds ahead of the vessel, giving them details about the ship. The manifolds then temporarily alter the conduit to optimise it for the vessel's parameters.
TECH_UNLOCK_TRANSWARP_ENGINE_9_DESC:
Transwarp Conduit IX 
The interspatial manifold network is now responsible for maintaining the transwarp conduits and autonomously growing the network. This transwarp coil is able to automatically link to the interspatial manifolds ahead of the vessel, giving them details about the ship.

TECH_UNLOCK_UNDINE_REACTOR_2_DESC:
Fluidic Amplification Reactor 
Specially applied concentrated bursts of nuclear energy against bio-matter generates powerful reactions that can be harvested for energy production. This energy is then amplified using the psychic power of the Undine mind.
TECH_UNLOCK_UNDINE_REACTOR_3_DESC:
Fluidic Bio Reactor 
Specially mixed concentrations of fluidic matter and bio-matter generates powerful waves of energy that can be used to power Undine Technology.
TECH_UNLOCK_UNDINE_REACTOR_PK_DESC:
Psi Projection Generator 
Mass detonation of biomass is harnessed by the powerful minds of Undine engineers and directed towards powering their most powerful vessels.
TECH_UNLOCK_UNDINE_SHIELD_1_DESC:
